items.summary: We are looking for a highly analytical, technology-forward Senior Financial Analyst to help improve financial visibility, accountability, and predictability across a multi-location business.
items.description: We are looking for a highly analytical, technology-forward Senior Financial Analyst to help improve financial visibility, accountability, and predictability across a multi-location business. This is not a traditional accounting role. The ideal candidate can analyze individual branch P&Ls, reconcile expenses and allocations, identify inconsistencies and opportunities, build financial models, and transform financial and operational data into clear, actionable dashboards for leadership. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with P&Ls, developing advanced Excel models, investigating changes in branch profitability, and using AI and business intelligence tools to automate reporting and uncover insights. The goal is to provide leadership with better financial visibility to support faster, more informed decisions around operations, staffing, investments, and business growth. Key Responsibilities Branch P&L Management & Reconciliation Own the review and reconciliation of individual branch P&Ls. Partner with Accounting, Finance, Operations, and branch leadership to validate expenses, allocations, revenue, compensation, and other financial activity. Research and resolve discrepancies between expected and actual branch expenses. Create standardized processes for reviewing branch financials and identifying errors before they become recurring issues. Maintain clear documentation around expense allocations and financial assumptions. Develop monthly branch-level financial reporting that allows leadership to quickly understand: Revenue Direct and allocated expenses Payroll and compensation Cost per unit Revenue per unit Contribution margin Branch profitability Break-even production Budget vs. actual performance Month-over-month and year-over-year trends Financial Modeling & Decision Support Build dynamic financial models to help leadership evaluate business decisions before capital is committed. Develop models covering: Branch profitability and break-even analysis New location pro formas Recruiting and hiring economics Compensation scenarios Headcount and staffing models Production and revenue forecasting Fixed vs. variable cost analysis Marketing ROI Office and occupancy costs Margin sensitivity Volume and profitability scenarios Create scenario models to evaluate potential changes in production, staffing, compensation, expenses, and other business variables. Analyze the financial impact of business decisions and identify opportunities to improve profitability and resource allocation. Determine break-even points, potential risks, and expected returns for proposed investments or initiatives. Dashboards & Business Intelligence Design and maintain executive dashboards that turn complex financial information into simple, actionable insights. Develop branch scorecards that allow leadership to quickly identify: Top and bottom-performing branches Expense anomalies Margin compression Profitability trends Cost-per-unit trends Staffing efficiency Production changes Budget variances Emerging financial risks Integrate financial and operational data from multiple systems wherever possible to reduce manual reporting. Build dashboards designed for decision-making rather than simply data presentation. AI, Automation & Process Improvement Use AI tools to improve financial analysis, reporting, reconciliation, and forecasting. Identify repetitive financial processes that can be automated. Use modern AI tools to assist with: Data analysis Variance detection Financial modeling Dashboard development Data cleanup Reporting automation Trend identification Executive summaries Forecasting and scenario analysis Continuously evaluate new tools and technologies that can improve the speed and accuracy of financial reporting. Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to streamline workflows, improve data quality, and support more efficient financial decision-making. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise 5+ years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, corporate finance, accounting analytics, business intelligence, or a similar analytical role. Strong understanding of P&Ls, general ledger activity, expense allocations, accruals, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including complex formulas, financial models, scenario analysis, pivot tables, and large datasets. Experience building dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar business intelligence platforms. Strong working knowledge of AI tools and demonstrated ability to use AI to improve analytical or reporting workflows. Experience combining and analyzing information from multiple data sources. Ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable recommendations for executives and non-financial leaders. Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to identify inconsistencies and challenge questionable data. Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Experience supporting multi-location, distributed, franchise, retail, or other organizations with branch- or unit-level financial reporting is highly preferred. Benefits Above market salary HMO on Day 1 for principal and two dependents Government-mandated benefits Performance-based Incentives Quarterly Company Events 1,000 PHP De Minimis Equipment and software provided Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Job Location: Remote About the Role: Sun King is seeking a high-impact GIS Specialist to significantly strengthen how geospatial insights inform our work across Africa. We have already established a strong foundation in using geospatial data to assess energy needs alongside our market reach. This role will build on that momentum by shaping our technology stack, sourcing high-quality data, and developing a reliable platform that enables the effective use of geospatial insights across the organisation. This role applies advanced spatial methods to inform key business areas, contributing to improved sales planning, operational effectiveness, policy engagement, and participation in subsidy programmes. The successful candidate brings strong GIS expertise within the energy sector, familiarity with African electrification and socio-demographic datasets, and experience developing production-ready GIS tools and platforms. Equally important is the ability to work across teams and ensure geospatial insights are meaningfully applied throughout the organisation. What you would be expected to do: Geospatial Infrastructure & Data Management Design, build, and maintain Sun King ’s internal geospatial data environment, consolidating electrification plans, socioeconomic datasets, grid maps, demographic layers, mobility data, and other spatial resources across markets. Develop and maintain geospatial databases with a strong focus on data quality, consistency, and ease of access. Integrate Sun King ’s proprietary data (sales performance, agent networks, customer locations, asset positions, and operational activity) into GIS platforms. Advanced Spatial Work & Business Integration Streamline GIS workflows and develop custom scripts to improve processing speed and efficiency. Work closely with Data & BI teams to incorporate GIS outputs into company dashboards and planning tools (for example, Tableau or Power BI). Develop or coordinate interactive, web-based visualisation platforms and layered GIS maps that combine demographic, economic, and infrastructure data for use by internal and external stakeholders. Partner with software development teams to integrate GIS data and market potential models into mobile applications used by field teams. Knowledge Exchange & Stakeholder Engagement Present complex spatial insights in clear, practical ways that enable action among non-technical teams. Enable internal teams to apply geospatial tools and outputs effectively in their work. Coordinate relationships with external GIS partners, research institutions, and data providers. You might be a strong candidate if you have: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Geography, GIS, Remote Sensing, Data Science, Energy Planning, or a related field. Experience applying GIS within the energy sector, including electrification planning, grid expansion modelling, or off-grid market assessments. Experience working with open-source and/or commercial GIS platforms (such as ArcGIS, QGIS, or equivalent enterprise systems) for modelling, data management, and spatial work. Experience automating workflows using scripting languages, preferably Python (for example, GeoPandas and related libraries). Familiarity with visualisation and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau for incorporating spatial insights into organisational dashboards. Familiarity with African electrification and development datasets, including grid maps, electrification models, census data, night-time lights, demographic surveys (DHS, LSMS), and national energy plans. Experience contributing to end-to-end GIS systems that align with broader organisational workflows, including exposure to cloud-based data pipelines and APIs (such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud). The ability to work across teams and translate spatial insights into clear, usable outputs. Strong communication and storytelling skills, with an ability to use maps to convey engaging narratives. What Sun King offers: Professional growth in a dynamic, rapidly expanding, high-social-impact industry An open-minded, collaborative culture made up of enthusiastic colleagues who are driven by the challenge of innovation towards profound impact on people and the planet. A truly multicultural experience: you will have the chance to work with and learn from people from different geographies, nationalities, and backgrounds. Structured, tailored learning and development programs that help you become a better leader, manager, and professional through the Sun Center for Leadership. We place great importance on sustaining a diverse, inclusive work environment. We believe that innovation and understanding comes from diversity on every spectrum. We work to make sure every Sun King team member knows that they belong, knowing that sustaining an inclusive workplace requires conscious effort and is a continuous journey, not an end-state. Sun King recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes people based on their experience, skills, effort, and results. We explicitly prohibit discrimination on the basis of race, religion, caste, national origin, color, gender, marital status, family structure, sexual orientation, HIV/AIDS status, or disability. items.description: About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our core Panel Science team. Our team is dedicated to building an uncompromising, mathematically rigorous single source of truth for enterprise consumer analytics. In this role, you will work across a highly sophisticated data engine that bridges foundational statistical modeling, complex data infrastructure, and advanced analytical product architecture. Whether your deep expertise lies in refining core statistical baselines, optimizing heavy computational models, or architecting scalable logic libraries, you will have a massive impact on how enterprise-level consumer insights are delivered. This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding. We expect East Coast work hours. As Our Corporate Data Scientist, You Will: Statistical Modeling & Distribution Optimization: Design, validate, and deploy robust, scalable optimization frameworks and distribution models to ensure complete mathematical integrity across downstream metrics. Methodology & Panel Foundations: Explore and execute complex methodologies, evaluate methodological trade-offs, and implement advanced statistical procedures. Analytical Logic & Governance: Partner cross-functionally to transition ad hoc code into standardized, version-controlled templates and logical libraries. You will ensure analytics are structured cleanly to power diverse product surfaces, ranging from interactive dashboards to LLM-driven applications. Infrastructure & Performance Optimization: Partner closely with Data Engineering to optimize code performance and scale analytical workflows. You will help transition complex statistical calculations from standard database queries into efficient, production-grade cloud compute architectures. You Are Likely To Succeed If: Experience: 4–5 years of professional data science experience. 2-3 years of experience with an advanced degree. Education: Bachelor’s degree in a highly quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related discipline). A Master’s degree is strongly preferred . Mathematical Proficiency: Exceptional expertise in working with, modeling, and optimizing for statistical distributions . Technical Stack: Advanced proficiency in Python or R and expert-level SQL . Key Advantages (Big Plus): Direct experience working with panel data or longitudinal consumer data. Hands-on experience analyzing receipt data or transaction-level consumer data. Experience working with Databricks and scaling advanced compute workloads. Software Product Manager Location: Remote Position Summary The Software Product Manager is responsible for defining and leading the strategy, roadmap, delivery, adoption, performance, and lifecycle of assigned software products and platform capabilities. This role serves as the voice of the customer and market, translating validated user problems, business objectives, product data, technical constraints, and competitive insights into clear outcomes, prioritized investments, and executable plans. As a key member of the Platform Product Management team, the Software Product Manager owns assigned software products and platform capabilities from problem discovery and business-case development through delivery, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement. This position is accountable for establishing a compelling product vision, defining measurable outcomes, and making evidence-based prioritization decisions that improve customer value, revenue growth, retention, operational efficiency, and strategic differentiation. The Software Product Manager works closely with Product Design, Engineering, Architecture, Data, Quality Assurance, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Regulatory, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Support, and regional teams. Success in this role requires the ability to lead through influence, balance customer and business needs with technical considerations, and enable agile teams to deliver secure, scalable, accessible, and supportable software solutions. Essential Functions Define and communicate product vision, strategy, target customers, value proposition, positioning, and measurable objectives in alignment with portfolio and company goals. Lead continuous product discovery through customer interviews, workflow observation, usage analysis, market research, competitive analysis, and concept or prototype validation. Translate validated customer problems and strategic opportunities into outcome-based roadmaps, product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release goals, and prioritized backlogs. Apply consistent prioritization methods and make clear tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, delivery effort, technical health, risk, and time to learning. Partner closely with Engineering and Product Design throughout discovery and delivery to clarify intent, reduce ambiguity, review progress, and adapt scope based on learning. Define product and feature success measures, instrumentation, and dashboards. Evaluate adoption, activation, engagement, retention, customer satisfaction, product quality, cost-to-serve, and revenue impact. Run experiments and post-launch reviews, using customer feedback and product data to determine whether to iterate, scale, reposition, or discontinue investments. Own the full software product lifecycle, including release planning, launch readiness, adoption, maintenance, migrations, deprecation, end-of-life planning, and customer communications. Partner with Engineering, R&D, Portfolio Owners, Quality Assurance, Security, Privacy, and Regulatory teams to incorporate scalability, reliability, interoperability, data governance, compliance, accessibility, supportability, and technical debt into product decisions. Guide platform, API, integration, data, and entitlement decisions to support cohesive customer workflows and sustainable product architecture. Develop business cases and contribute to pricing, packaging, forecasting, investment planning, and build-buy-partner recommendations. Lead go-to-market and release-readiness planning with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, Training, and regional teams. Support positioning, enablement, documentation, migration, and adoption planning for new and existing software capabilities. Provide concise, decision-oriented updates regarding outcomes, roadmap changes, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and tradeoffs to customers, delivery teams, stakeholders, and senior leaders. Promote modern product management practices, responsible and ethical use of data and AI where applicable, and a culture of customer empathy, accountability, learning, and continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Product Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, Design, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of software product management experience. Experience owning customer-facing software, SaaS products, enterprise applications, digital platforms, or data products from discovery through post-launch optimization. Demonstrated experience delivering software capabilities and improving measurable customer or business outcomes. Experience with product discovery, product strategy, roadmapping, prioritization, requirements definition, agile product delivery, launch management, adoption, optimization, and lifecycle planning. Experience developing product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release goals, and prioritized product backlogs. Experience working with cross-functional Engineering, Design, Quality, Security, Data, Commercial, Customer Success, and Support teams. Ability to define and track product KPIs and use data to evaluate customer behavior and product performance. Technical understanding of modern software concepts including cloud services, APIs, integrations, data models, identity and access management, observability, release pipelines, and architectural tradeoffs. Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder communication skills. Ability to influence without direct authority and create alignment across cross-functional and distributed teams. Ability to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities. Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and product collaboration tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, Power BI, or comparable platforms. Schedule flexibility to collaborate with international teams across multiple time zones. Preferred Qualifications Experience with B2B software products, regulated industries, laboratory workflows, food safety, connected instruments, or global products. Experience using SQL, product analytics tools, or business intelligence platforms to evaluate product performance. Experience analyzing funnels, cohorts, experiments, adoption metrics, and customer behavior. Working knowledge of secure software development, privacy by design, accessibility, regulatory or quality requirements, and operational resilience. Experience supporting platform, API, integration, data, or entitlement strategy. Experience with pricing, packaging, forecasting, investment planning, or build-buy-partner analysis. Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of how product decisions affect revenue, retention, margin, customer value, and cost-to-serve. Experience leading go-to-market, release-readiness, customer migration, and product adoption initiatives. Experience with responsible use of artificial intelligence, data, or emerging technologies within software products. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Strong customer empathy and product judgment. items.summary: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world.
items.description: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically. Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space — ready to join us? What's the position? As Customer Quality & Insights Manager, you will build and lead how Hard Rock Digital understands and acts on customer sentiment. This is a zero-to-one role: the function doesn't exist yet, and you will be the one to organize various efforts into one cohesive strategy — the reporting, the process, and eventually the team. At the center of the role is a closed loop, and running that loop well is the actual job: identify where sentiment is slipping, diagnose what's driving it, get the finding to the team who can fix it, and then track what happens after the fix ships to confirm it actually moved the needle. Anything short of closing the loop is just reporting; closing it is what makes the role valuable. You will organize diagnosis around three pillars that drive customer sentiment: Person (how interactions are handled), Product (how our app and platform perform for customers), and Policy (how our processes and rules affect the experience). Your job is to find the story in the data and hand stakeholders something specific they can act on — not to audit or score individual performance. When a finding touches an individual interaction, your role is to surface the pattern and hand it to the team that owns coaching or process change, not to run that conversation yourself. This role reports directly to the Senior Manager, Operations Strategy & Insights. There are no direct reports today, but as the function grows, so will this team. You will work alongside the existing BI Operations function — the two teams are parallel, and you'll partner closely with them on shared data and stakeholder context. Responsibilities Building the function Stand up the customer sentiment/insights function: the reporting, the classification taxonomy, and the closed-loop process end to end. Define and own how the loop works across the org — from issue identification through post-implementation impact tracking — so stakeholders know how to engage with findings and recommendations. Build the case for future headcount and, if approved, onboard and manage a Quality & Insights Analyst. Represent the Insights function in cross-functional forums as the org's point of contact for customer sentiment. Sentiment measurement & reporting Build and maintain CSAT and sentiment reporting that gives stakeholders a clear, ongoing view of customer sentiment trends. Design and evolve a sentiment taxonomy that reliably classifies feedback into the Person, Product, and Policy pillars. Mine reviews, support tickets, surveys, and other qualitative feedback sources for sentiment signal, using AI tools to accelerate classification and pattern detection. Track sentiment trends over time and proactively surface emerging issues before they show up as escalations. Diagnosing what's driving sentiment When sentiment dips or a pattern emerges, dig into the underlying story: is it how an interaction was handled, a product friction point, or a policy/process design issue? Distinguish one-off incidents from systemic patterns, and prioritize investigations toward the issues with the greatest sentiment impact. Turn what you find into a clear, specific narrative stakeholders can act on — the goal is to explain what's driving the pattern, not to audit or score any individual's performance. Closing the loop Route findings to the team best positioned to act on them (people leadership, product, policy/process owners) with a specific, actionable recommendation. Maintain a running view of every open issue's status in the loop: identified, diagnosed, routed, and resolved. Track outcomes after a fix ships to confirm whether it actually moved sentiment, and close the loop back to the original finding. Present findings and loop status clearly to stakeholders, including team leads and cross-functional partners who own the Product and Policy pillars. Build data-backed business cases when a recommendation requires investment, prioritization, or a change to an existing process. Data foundation Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate sentiment and CSAT data across large, complex datasets. Validate data integrity and ensure sentiment classifications and diagnostic findings are grounded in accurate, well-understood sources. Create and maintain clear documentation for sentiment definitions, classification methodology, and recurring reports. Collaborate with the BI Operations team on shared data, metrics, and stakeholder context to ensure consistency across functions. Requirements What are we looking for? 6–9 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, customer experience, or a related field, including experience owning a function, workstream, or reporting capability with significant ambiguity. Proficient SQL skills, including the ability to write and join queries across multiple data sources (CSAT, NPS, support systems) to build reporting independently. Experience building and maintaining dashboards or reporting (Tableau or similar) that stakeholders rely on directly. Demonstrated ability to diagnose the underlying driver behind a pattern in customer feedback and turn it into a specific, actionable recommendation. Experience using AI tools within an analytical workflow, including sentiment classification, text analysis, or LLM-assisted review of qualitative feedback. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn analysis into a recommendation and land it with stakeholders who don't report to you. Comfort working across both quantitative data (CSAT scores, trend lines) and qualitative material (reviews, transcripts, case notes). Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Business, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Nice to have Prior experience building or standing up a new reporting function or capability from the ground up. People management experience. Familiarity with contact center or customer support operations and workflows. Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse. Python experience, particularly for text/sentiment analysis (pandas, NLTK, or similar). Experience in iGaming, online sportsbook, casino, or a regulated industry environment. What’s in it for you? We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include: Competitive pay and benefits Flexible vacation allowance A hybrid / remote working environment Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand Roster of Uniques We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer). Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Frontend Web Application Developer
items.summary: Location: Remote Availability: 35-40 hours per week Working hours: US East business hours Reporting to: Lead developer KoboToolbox has an immediate opening for a Frontend Web Application Developer to fill a full-time position of approximately 35-40 hours per week, for a commitment of at least 1 year. As a member of our team, you will share in the challenge and excitement of writing code used by over 32,000 organizations around the world. These organizations create data-driven change through the collection and analysis of more than 20 million surveys per month. Only candidates who already have experience working on large web applications will be considered. Beyond technical acumen, we are seeking a team member who demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and a cooperative approach to problem solving and decision-making. If you're passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact, we want to hear from you! Responsibilities Searching and reading an extensive, long-lived code base to understand existing behavior and conventions. Recognizing when existing conventions may no longer be the best approach and suggesting improvements aligned with contemporary best practices. Writing robust, concise, and reusable code with accompanying tests and documentation. Reviewing other developers' code and providing constructive feedback. Incorporating feedback from code reviews to improve your skills and align with team standards. Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining responsibility for code quality and correctness. Efficiently investigating bug reports from the support team, creating well-scoped fixes or actionable plans for resolution. Scoping, prioritizing, estimating, and organizing work into manageably sized tasks. Attending regular video-conference check-ins with other members of the technical team. Communicating with the public in conjunction with our support staff or directly through forums, issue trackers, etc. Contributing to discussions about design and architecture collaboratively with the larger team. Performing other related duties as directed by the lead developer. Requirements Required Qualifications Professional experience writing, deploying, and maintaining client-side code for real-world, API-driven single-page applications. Proficiency with TypeScript, React, and related technologies, including styling, state management, and efficient data exchange over HTTP. Unflinching ability to work with legacy technologies such as Backbone and CoffeeScript. Recent experience giving and receiving code reviews. Ability to independently set up and troubleshoot a local development environment, knowing when to ask for help on genuine roadblocks. Interest in data collection (surveying), particularly in humanitarian emergencies and other challenging contexts, and a desire to improve our platform for our users. Proficiency with spoken and written English. Fluency with Git. Overlap with working hours in the Eastern time zone. Average availability of at least 30 hours per week, preferably 35 hours or more. Preferred Qualifications Experience with the following is preferred but not required to apply: Using Docker and Docker Compose in a development environment. Programming in Python, ideally with Django (and particularly Django REST Framework). Building user-facing LLM integrations. Surveying with XLSForm, ODK XForm, and OpenRosa. Integrating with Stripe for payment processing. An added note on qualifications... We know that people from underrepresented groups including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and others are less likely to apply for a role if they don't meet every qualification listed. We're more interested in your potential and growth mindset than a perfect checklist match. If this role excites you and you meet many, but not all, of the qualifications, we'd still love to hear from you. Equal Opportunity Employer Kobo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Benefits Genuine Impact: Contribute directly to projects that impact millions of people around the world globally, working alongside the largest international humanitarian organizations as well as thousands of national and small community based partners in 200 countries. Meaningful Work Environment: Join a team that believes work should be meaningful as well as fun, tackling global challenges through innovative data collection and management tools with a proven impact for lasting change. Diverse Team: Be part of an amazing, progressive, and globally diverse team that values diversity, equity, and inclusion across all spectrums. Flexible Work Culture: Enjoy mutual flexibility supported by a culture that prioritizes work-life balance. Professional Development: Benefit from generous professional development options. Full Time Employee Benefits (U.S. candidates only) : Health & Wellness : 5 medical insurance options, dental, and vision (up to 80% premium covered), plus life insurance and Long Term Disability. Financial Security : 401(k) retirement plan with 100% match up to 2%. Work-Life Balance : 20 days paid time off, 12 floating holidays, unlimited sick days, and paid parental leave. *Please note, if based in the US or Canada this is a full time employee position. In other locations full time employment or contractor positions are options depending on individual circumstances.

items.title: Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher
items.summary: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher.
items.description: Why This Role As a Blockchain Data Analyst & Researcher, you will be a pivotal force in our data intelligence efforts, serving primarily as a blockchain data protocol researcher. Your core mission will involve a deep dive into the complex internals and mechanics of various blockchain networks, reverse engineering of sophisticated Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols, and translating these complex systems into actionable, structured data. Develop new derivative data models and datasets for client insights and competitive advantages. Map, cleanse, and normalize raw, disparate blockchain data (transaction logs, smart contract events, state changes) into consistent, structured relational and non-relational schemes for consumption by analytics, machine learning, and AI tools. This role requires a unique blend of expertise in distributed systems, data engineering best practices, and a profound understanding of the crypto and decentralized ecosystem. What You’ll Do Maintain an AI-native and blockchain-forward mindset, proactively leveraging emerging trends and generative technologies to stay at the vanguard of the crypto revolution while maximizing work efficiency and uncovering novel, high-alpha data opportunities. Architect Intuitive Data Models: Turn the messiness of on-chain data into elegant, unified abstractions. You'll build the models that provide our users with granular, high-integrity insights across various protocols. Deconstruct DeFi Mechanics: Get under the hood of DeFi protocols. You'll reverse-engineer smart contracts and on-chain events, translating complex interactions into clean, production-grade SQL/dbt models. Scale Our Ecosystem Coverage: Lead the charge in indexing new blockchains. You’ll design the schemas that transform raw chain data into our internal "source of truth," ensuring every block is captured with 100% accuracy. Engineer Signal from Noise: Define the metrics that matter (TVL, Volume, Fees). You’ll be the gatekeeper of data quality, proactively identifying and filtering out wash trading, bot activity, and Sybil attacks. What You'll Need: Experience 3+ years hands-on in Data Science, Data Engineering, or a hybrid role; Blockchain or crypto analytics background strongly preferred, familiarity with on-chain data structures, transaction semantics, and asset classification; Streaming & Lakehouse Apache Flink or Spark Streaming building and operating real-time data pipelines; Apache Iceberg or Apache Hudi managing large-scale Data Lakehouses with schema evolution, time travel, and ACID guarantees over petabytes of raw blockchain data; AWS Data Platform S3 for scalable data lake storage; RDS for structured relational workloads; Spark SQL and PySpark for interactive querying and ad-hoc analysis; Caching & Distribution Familiarity with Data Grid technologies (e.g. Hazelcast, Apache Ignite, Redis) for high-throughput, low-latency data access patterns; Languages & Tooling SQL advanced query writing, window functions, query plan analysis, performance tuning at scale; Python Pandas, Polars for data wrangling; Scikit-learn for model development; Proficient in architecting high-throughput ingestion pipelines that leverage external data sources REST/WebSocket APIs, JSON-RPC node queries; Strong grasp of ETL fundamentals (extract, transform, load), including managing schema mismatches between heterogeneous sources and destinations; Engineering Mindset Systematic approach to debugging: reproducing issues, isolating root cause, validating fixes; Comfortable working with large, semi-structured, or undocumented data sources. Why Join Lukka ? Are you looking for a challenge? Lukka solves the most complex data and technology challenges for an industry that is at the forefront of innovation. At Lukka , we strive to anticipate and respond to the needs of this new and ever-changing ecosystem of digital assets. That was true in 2014, while everyone was focused on trading & buying this new asset class, we were thinking about the tax implications of crypto. That innovative foresight continues today as we evolve and iterate on our product suite to address the regulations and educate our customers. We are looking for passionate, collaborative, and strategic individuals who want to help shape the future of, well, everything – starting with making crypto more accountable. We invest in our teammates, promote from within & are responsible to each other by fostering an inclusive space for curious minds to thrive and innovate. What’s life @ Lukka like? We move fast and continue to be ahead of the curve. You could be part of a growing company bridging the gap between business and blockchain. Here’s some insight into why our team members have joined: Ability to own the projects they work on; Less red tape to take ideas from inception to delivery; Being at the forefront of an industry; Small team, big dreams. Of course, let’s discuss some perks: Opportunity to work directly on data for digital assets, an industry-leading product with well-known clients. Working with multiple AI solutions daily. Exposure to both technical problem-solving and customer-facing challenges. A growing Poland-based team with direct collaboration across US and global stakeholders. A startup-style culture where your impact is visible every day. So you’ve scrolled, your interest is piqued and hopefully read all of the important things...now what? This is an exciting time to join a team that’s at the forefront of this rapidly growing industry. We are looking for people who constantly push themselves to think differently, are ready to face new challenges and chart exciting new paths. If this sounds like you, apply! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Join Our Vision: We are building the next generation of Spatial Media - a new way people experience videos through interaction, multi-user presence, haptics, AI, and immersive storytelling.
items.description: Join Our Vision: We are building the next generation of Spatial Media - a new way people experience videos through interaction, multi-user presence, haptics, AI, and immersive storytelling. DeoVR is the leading immersive streaming technology serving multiple enterprise customers and millions of users globally. We are now expanding the boundaries of what video can be - moving from passive watching to active, interactive, multi-user journeys. If this excites you more than it scares you, you are in the right place. The Role We’re looking for a strong Head of Product Analytics who can combine strategic ownership with a very hands-on approach. This is not a pure management role - we expect someone who is individually strong enough to operate at a Senior Product Analyst level and enjoys working deeply with data. We need someone who sees analytics as a product function, not just reporting. Someone proactive, curious, and opinionated. A person who can help shape product decisions, uncover growth opportunities, build reliable tracking systems, and turn data into actionable insights. What You Will Do Own and develop the product analytics function Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams Proactively identify what should be analyzed, validated, or challenged — without waiting for requests from Product or Leadership Run deep product analysis to identify opportunities for growth and optimization Drive product decisions with data, not just respond to ad-hoc requests Design event tracking from scratch and maintain scalable, reliable analytics instrumentation Own data quality and metric consistency across the product Improve and optimize the DWH layer, including data modeling and performance optimization Build and maintain dashboards and analytical layers Develop product metrics, frameworks, and measurement approaches Help teams make faster and better product decisions through data What We Are Looking For Strong experience in product analytics at Senior or Lead level Very hands-on mindset - comfortable digging into data yourself Advanced SQL skills and experience writing complex, optimized queries Strong Python skills for analytics and data processing Solid experience with BI tools - we use Tableau Experience building event tracking systems from the ground up Strong understanding of DWH design and optimization Strong understanding of A/B testing methodologies, including bootstrapping, sequential testing, multi-armed bandits, and causal inference Real hands-on experience applying ML approaches to analytics and product problems Product mindset and ability to translate data into meaningful business and product insights Bonus Points Experience with video streaming products Experience working with recommendation systems Experience optimizing product funnels and user journeys Experience in fast-growing product companies Hiring Process HR screening (30 min) Tech Interview (1 hour) Product Team Interview (1 hour) CEO Interview (45 min) 💼 Explore our hiring process. What We Offer Please note, that this is a fully remote contract role. B2B cooperation only – you will work with us as an independent contractor operating through your own legal business entity (e.g., sole proprietorship, limited company, or equivalent). The chance to be part of a pioneering team in a rapidly evolving industry Direct impact on the future of media and technology Flexible working hours to accommodate your lifestyle Work remotely from almost anywhere A culture that values innovation, accountability, and collaboration Access to the tech you need from day one Unlimited DeoVR Premium subscription A dynamic and innovative work environment in a cutting-edge industry 🎥 Unlocking Immersive Experiences: Ivan Varko’s vision, CEO of Infomediji . STAY CONNECTED Join our Facebook community to connect with like-minded people. Join us and embrace a role where your expertise meets technological innovation. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Senior Data and BI Analyst / Developer - (Remote - LATAM)
items.summary: Orchid Software Solutions | Remote, Latin America | Full-time contract About usOrchid Software Solutions builds and operates software for healthcare and family-building services.
items.description: Orchid Software Solutions | Remote, Latin America | Full-time contract About us Orchid Software Solutions builds and operates software for healthcare and family-building services. Our products cover escrow for surrogacy and egg donation, agency management for fertility clinics, medical records retrieval, insurance risk management, and independent dispute resolution for healthcare payments under the federal No Surprises Act. Our engineering team is distributed across the United States and Latin America, with a few colleagues further afield. We work remotely, in writing, and across time zones. About the role This is our first dedicated data and business intelligence role. You will own reporting end to end: the data model, the metric definitions, the dashboards our operations teams run on, and the reporting our enterprise clients see. You will start with our healthcare payments dispute resolution product, which has the largest data footprint and the most immediate reporting need. Once that reporting is running, the role expands across our other products, bringing one set of definitions to metrics that are currently produced product by product. The interesting part of this job is not the dashboards. Much of what our applications display is calculated at read time by application code rather than stored in a column, so the same question can be answered several ways. Your job is to decide what each metric means, document it, prove it reconciles against the systems of record, and defend that definition when someone wants a different number. If you like being the person whose figures nobody argues with, you will like this role. You will work alongside an engineering team of senior fullstack engineers and QA, a product manager, and business leadership in the United States. You will present your numbers directly to executives and to client counterparts, so this is a role for someone comfortable in front of an audience, not only in a query editor. What you will do Build and maintain internal reporting for operational volume, case status and stage, cycle and resolution time, throughput, and service-level metrics. Own payment reconciliation reporting, where the tolerance for an approximate answer is zero. Design and ship scoped, self-service reporting for enterprise clients, so they can answer their own questions without going through our support team. Model data in our analytics warehouse: dimensional models, incremental transformations, and tested, documented pipelines. Own the metric layer. One definition per metric, the query that produces it, the business rule behind it, and a data dictionary anyone can read. Reconcile reporting against the source systems and keep it reconciled as the applications change. Work with role-scoped access and data minimization as a matter of routine. We handle regulated healthcare and payment data, and reporting is built to keep sensitive fields out of it. Improve data quality. Find the defects that make reporting wrong, quantify them, and drive the fixes with the engineering team. Turn ambiguous questions from executives and clients into defined metrics, and say so when a question cannot be answered from the data we hold. Extend the same patterns and definitions to our other products as the function grows. What we are looking for Expert SQL. Complex analytical queries, window functions, and query performance work. You can tell the difference between a number that is surprising and a number that is wrong. Hands-on warehouse experience. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Databricks. You have modeled data in one, not only queried someone else’s models. Dimensional and semantic modeling. You have built a reporting layer over a normalized transactional schema and owned the definitions that sat on top of it. Client-facing reporting, shipped. You have built reporting that external customers used, with the scoping and access controls that requires. You write code, not only queries. Production-quality work in Git, code review in both directions, and the ability to build and run your own transformation jobs. Stakeholder judgment. You can sit with an executive or a client, work out what they actually need, and push back when the ask does not hold up. Data governance in a regulated setting. Practical experience with role-based access, handling of personal or health data, and producing evidence for an audit. HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI, or similar. Clear written communication. Our team is distributed and most decisions happen in writing. Professional English, written and spoken. You will present to United States executives and to client counterparts. Fluency is required and is assessed in the first conversation. Time zone overlap. A minimum of four hours of daily overlap with United States Eastern time, 9:00 to 13:00 ET. Able to contract independently. You can invoice and contract as an independent professional in your country of residence, and accept confidentiality and data-handling terms covering regulated healthcare data. Nice to have Healthcare payments, claims, or payer and provider data. Experience with No Surprises Act dispute resolution is a real advantage. dbt or a comparable transformation framework, in production, with tests. Change data capture pipelines and the failure modes that come with them. Financial reconciliation reporting. Python for data work. Enough TypeScript to read an application and trace how a value is calculated. An embedded analytics or BI tool taken to production with external users, including row-level security. AWS, particularly RDS, S3, and IAM as it applies to data access. Prior work with a United States company in a regulated industry. What this role is not It is not a ticket queue for dashboard requests. You own definitions and you are expected to have opinions about them. It is not platform or infrastructure engineering. We have a platform team and you will partner with them. It is not machine learning or model development. That work sits with a separate team. Tech you will work with TypeScript and Next.js applications, MySQL and PostgreSQL as operational stores, ClickHouse as the analytics warehouse, change data capture between them, Python for data work, and AWS throughout. Our older products run on Python and Flask. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: deine aufgaben Betreuung und Begleitung der Teilnehmenden im Rahmen der praxisorientierten Unterrichtseinheiten über die Dauer der Weiterbildung Durchführung des Unterrichts im Online-Classroom für die Weiterbildungen Quantitative Investmentanalyse & Portfoliomanagement, Data Science, Business Intelligence sowie Datenbankmanagement & Datenanalyse Beantwortung fachlicher Fragen und Unterstützung der Teilnehmenden im Hinblick auf ihren Lernfortschritt Rückmeldung zu Lernfortschritten geben und konstruktives fachliches Feedback formulieren Einbringen von eigenen Ideen und fachlichem Know-how zur Weiterentwicklung der Weiterbildungsinhalte deine eigenschaften Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschafts-, Informations- oder Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich Erfahrung als Lehrkraft, wissenschaftliche:r Mitarbeiter:in, Trainer:in oder Dozent:in Fundierte Kenntnisse in Quantitative Finance, Data Science und Business Intelligence sowie in Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Jupyter Notebook, SQL, MySQL, Power BI und Tableau Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Themen verständlich zu vermitteln Methodenkompetenz zur gezielten Vermittlung praxisorientierter Aufgaben und zur Unterstützung der Teilnehmenden Ausgeprägte didaktische Fertigkeiten und Erfahrung in der Konzeption interaktiver Lernformate Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift wir suchen Für unsere Finance & Data-Weiterbildungen wird eine Lehrkraft gesucht, die Teilnehmende beim Aufbau fundierter Grundlagen in den Bereichen Finanzmarktanalyse, maschinellem Lernen, Datenvisualisierung und Datenbanken begleitet. Vermittelt werden zentrale Konzepte, Methoden, Techniken und Werkzeuge, die für einen erfolgreichen Einstieg in datenbezogene Tätigkeiten erforderlich sind. items.title: Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The Senior Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will lead the analysis, interpretation and management of institutional performance information to support evidence-based decision-making across ALU . The role will translate complex business, financial, operational, academic and student data into clear insights, identify performance trends and gaps, assess their underlying drivers, and provide actionable recommendations to improve institutional outcomes. The role will also strengthen ALU 's performance management and business intelligence capabilities, ensuring that leadership has timely, reliable and forward-looking information to guide strategic and operational decisions. Working across functions and with senior leaders, the role will connect institutional strategy, performance targets and operational results, providing the analysis and challenge required to improve execution and organisational performance. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Institutional Performance Management Lead the development, implementation and continuous improvement of ALU 's institutional performance framework, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance measures. Monitor performance against strategic and operational objectives, identify material variances, emerging risks and areas of underperformance, and recommend appropriate interventions. Lead periodic performance reviews and provide analysis that enables leadership to understand not only what is happening, but why it is happening and what action is required. Analyse performance across key institutional areas including enrolment, recruitment, retention, student progression, programme performance, revenue, costs, resource utilisation and other strategic priorities. Establish appropriate performance benchmarks and support leadership in setting meaningful, measurable and outcome-focused objectives and targets. Business and Strategic Analysis Identify trends, patterns, performance drivers and root causes across multiple sources of institutional data. Develop business cases, investment analyses and decision papers, including assessment of financial, operational and strategic implications. Undertake scenario analysis and modelling to assess the potential impact of strategic and operational decisions. Conduct complex business and institutional analysis to support strategic planning, operational decisions and strategic initiatives and prioritization. Provide objective analysis and constructive challenge where data, assumptions or proposed interventions require further scrutiny. Conduct internal and external benchmarking to assess institutional performance against relevant peer institutions, competitors, sector standards and market trends. Translate analytical findings into clear recommendations, implications and actions for senior leadership. Performance Intelligence and Reporting Lead the development of high-quality management information, executive performance reports, dashboards and analytical products for senior leadership and governance forums. Establish standards for performance reporting, data interpretation, and analytical storytelling. Ensure management reports focus on material performance issues, drivers, trends and decisions rather than simply presenting data. Develop forward-looking analysis and forecasts to support proactive management of institutional performance. Work with data and technology teams to improve access to, integration of and confidence in institutional data. Ensure the accuracy, consistency and appropriate interpretation of performance information used for management decision-making. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Develop clear standards for analytical quality, delivery and stakeholder service. Coach team members in analytical thinking, problem solving, business partnering and effective communication of insights. Develop and continuously improve analytical methodologies, tools and processes. Identify opportunities to automate, simplify and improve performance reporting and analysis. Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and stronger use of data across ALU . Partner with other functions to develop integrated views of institutional performance. Executive Stakeholder Engagement Establish and maintain data supply arrangements with the functions that own the underlying data: agreed definitions, cut dates, quality standards, and named counterparts. Resolve definitional inconsistency across campuses, programmes and systems so that the institution reports a single number for each institutional metric. Build effective working relationships with senior leaders, Deans, Directors and functional teams across ALU . Present complex analysis clearly to non-technical audiences and translate findings into practical business implications. Facilitate performance discussions and support leaders in identifying appropriate responses to performance gaps. Influence decisions through evidence, insight and constructive challenge, including where findings may challenge established assumptions or practices. Provide analytical support to strategic, executive and governance forums as required. Maintain a strong understanding of the ALU ’s operating environment, priorities and strategic objectives to ensure analysis remains relevant to institutional needs. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 10+ years of relevant professional experience in business performance, institutional research, strategy, business intelligence, analytics, planning, consulting, financial analysis or a related field. Demonstrable experience leading, developing and managing organisational or institutional performance frameworks, including KPIs, targets, scorecards and performance reporting. Proven experience analysing complex datasets and translating findings into actionable recommendations for senior decision-makers, forecasting, scenario modelling, business case development and quantitative analysis. Experience producing executive-level performance reports, dashboards and decision-support materials. Experience using data to identify performance drivers, diagnose problems and support measurable improvements in organisational outcomes. Demonstrated experience delivering analytical or performance improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable business, operational, financial or institutional impact. Experience benchmarking organisational or institutional performance against external peers, competitors or sector standards is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Strategic and Performance Analysis: Analyse complex institutional issues, identify performance drivers and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Data & Business Intelligence: Analyse complex datasets and develop clear dashboards, management information and performance insights. Financial & Commercial Acumen: Understand the financial, operational and institutional implications of decisions. Forecasting & Modelling: Develop forecasts, scenarios and business models to support planning and decision-making. Problem Solving: Diagnose root causes, test assumptions and develop practical, evidence-based solutions. Executive Reporting: Distil complex information into clear insights, implications and recommendations for senior leaders. Analytics Tools: Advanced Excel and strong proficiency in Power BI and uses digital and AI-enabled tools effectively to accelerate analysis, improve productivity and generate insight, while independently validating outputs and exercising sound judgement. Behavioural & Leadership Competencies Strategic Thinking: Connect performance trends and analysis to broader institutional priorities. Critical Thinking: Question assumptions and assess evidence objectively. Influencing & Challenge: Build credibility with senior stakeholders and challenge constructively using evidence. Executive Communication: Communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively to varied audiences. Collaboration: Work effectively across academic and professional functions. Leadership & Coaching: Develop people, set high analytical standards and build team capability. Delivery Orientation: Focus on turning insight into action and measurable institutional improvement. Match the ALU Archetype: Alignment with the ALU Archetype, including ownership, courage, and stewardship. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Tabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. items.title: Senior Growth Consultant - PM (Programmatic)
items.summary: Hi, we’re Phiture — the mobile growth consultancy working with the teams behind leading apps like Adobe, Headspace, and LEGO® 👋.
items.description: Hi, we’re Phiture — the mobile growth consultancy working with the teams behind leading apps like Adobe, Headspace, and LEGO® 👋. We’re setting the standard for growth in the brave new digital world, and we need great people to join our global team! WHAT TO EXPECT: Join Phiture as a Senior Growth Consultant, PM (Programmatic ), owning the day-to-day relationship, communication, and delivery for one or more client accounts. You'll act as the main technical point of contact for client communications, owning conversations and decisions directly with the client, while advising the Growth Lead on strategy and execution. This is a hands-on, individual account-ownership role. You'll bring deep expertise in paid user acquisition for mobile apps — including SDKs, SKAN's measurement restrictions, the DSP/SSP landscape, and MMPs — and apply it to scale programmatic media buys efficiently. WHAT YOU’LL DO: Own Programmatic Campaign Management: Own the end-to-end strategy, setup, and continuous optimization of programmatic media buys (DSPs) to scale user acquisition efficiently, proactively monitoring spend efficiency and creative performance, and independently investigating platform-level technical issues (tracking discrepancies, delivery problems, campaign configuration) before escalating. Own the Client Relationship: Own the client relationship end-to-end — day-to-day communication, deliverables (reports, proposals, strategic planning docs), and hands-on execution of the agreed strategy. Lead client meetings, educate clients beyond reporting, and communicate the real, accurate cause of any issue, including when it traces back to our own setup or execution. Apply App-Specific Paid Media Expertise: Bring deep expertise in paid user acquisition specifically for mobile apps — SDKs and their implementation, SKAN's measurement restrictions and their implications for testing and attribution, the DSP/SSP landscape, and what an MMP does and why app marketers rely on one. Bridge Creative & Performance Data: Read performance data well enough to turn it into real learnings — which messages, angles, or formats are working, and why — and use those insights to brief the creative team and discuss creative direction with them as a peer. Analyze Performance & Drive Recommendations: Dive deep into monthly metrics, set targets, analyze trends, and independently identify areas of concern or opportunity, arriving with a point of view and a recommendation grounded in the numbers. Comfort building or reading dashboards in a tool like Looker Studio is expected at a Senior level. Guide Client POCs & Junior Team Members: Lightly guide Client POCs and junior team members as they build expertise, while retaining individual ownership of your own accounts. Given a problem, investigate it, propose a course of action, follow through, and close the loop with stakeholders without needing reminders. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Solid app-specific paid UA fluency: including SDKs, SKAN, MMP concepts, and the DSP/SSP landscape. Hands-on DSP/programmatic campaign management experience: this is core to the role from day one. Independent data interpretation skills: able to arrive at a point of view and recommendation grounded in the numbers, rather than generic or AI-sounding analysis. Strong written and verbal client communication skills: with confidence leading client meetings and educating clients beyond reporting. A demonstrated track record of proactive ownership: able to walk through a real past troubleshooting example without prompting. Genuine interest in programmatic as a channel: this role is programmatic-heavy. Comfort in an individual account-ownership role : rather than a team-leadership one. NICE TO HAVE: Hands-on experience with DV360 specifically: a strong differentiator for this role. Hands-on experience with at least one MMP (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, or similar): including reading and troubleshooting attribution data — the single strongest differentiator for this role. WHAT WE OFFER YOU: Flexible Remote Work — Unlimited remote work within your home country (EMEA), plus up to 90 days per year internationally. Generous Vacation Allowance — Enjoy up to 30 days of paid vacation annually, plus extra days for special occasions (country-specific), so you can recharge and pursue your passions. Quarterly Bonus Opportunities — Boost your earnings through our quarterly bonus scheme, directly linked to our shared success. Mental Wellness Prioritized — Free, confidential mental health support from licensed therapists through our partnership with Oliva. Personal Development Investment — €1,000 annual personal growth budget and 10 dedicated learning hours each month, empowering your continuous growth. Flexible Working Hours — Shape your workday around your lifestyle and productivity, choosing working patterns that best suit you. Vibrant Berlin Office — Enjoy a flexible, pet-friendly workspace at our spacious headquarters located in one of Berlin’s most vibrant neighborhoods. Global Team Connection — Regular team-building events and a memorable annual all-expenses-paid company offsite. Tailored Career Growth — A personalized career roadmap and development plan designed to keep you advancing professionally. Home Office Allowance — Monthly remote-work cash allowance to level up your home workspace or help cover internet costs. Premium Onboarding Kit — Branded Phiture gear and your very own MacBook from day one. Thoughtful Celebrations — Responsibly sourced birthday, anniversary, and seasonal gifts, because every milestone deserves recognition. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of their age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. We celebrate diversity and are excited about building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. Originally posted on Himalayas

Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some o
items.description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer. Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI. Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes). Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis. Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel. Requirements Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company. Strong SQL and Python , with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics. Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics. Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders , and pushing back on ill-defined asks. Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour. Bonus Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product. Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers. Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access. Growth potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales. Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI). Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track. Location This role is remote-first. [please fill with specific location / timezone requirements]. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
