items.title: Senior Research Manager - Animal Welfare
items.summary: About the roleRethink Priorities' Animal Welfare Department produces research and strategic advice to help organizations make well-informed decisions for animals.
items.description: About the role Rethink Priorities ' Animal Welfare Department produces research and strategic advice to help organizations make well-informed decisions for animals . The Department is splitting into three teams. The AI and Animals Team helps organisations navigate an AI-transforming world. The Frontiers Team advances the field of animal welfare, focusing on neglected animals (such as shrimp) and emerging topics (such as breeding for welfare). And a new Animal Welfare Strategy Team, described below. The Animal Welfare Strategy Team (working name) will focus on supporting and accelerating funders and organizations toward achieving their core goals of accelerating the end of low-welfare farming and reducing the suffering of animals on farms , with a focus on terrestrial vertebrates. This will involve a mix of consulting work, in-house research, and other activities. Recent consulting work has included economic analysis of egg prices for a policy advocacy organization, prioritization of welfare-tech ideas for a venture studio, and research on alternative-protein regulation to guide a large grantmaker with a $10m+ portfolio. RP is independent: clients get the answers that the evidence supports, whether or not they are the ones they hoped for. In-house research might involve building data tools and resources to map where animals are suffering on farms, or strategic analysis to guide stakeholders' decisions. The team will also run the annual Animal Advocacy Strategy Forum, which brings together leaders from across the animal welfare landscape. Going forward, it may build capacity for other actions to enable the success for existing and new projects, such as regranting or talent programs. The department seeks to hire a Senior Research Manager to lead this new Animal Welfare Strategy Team . This is a leadership role in a Department that is growing and being restructured. You will need to work with the Director to set a strategy for this team covering how the team prioritizes projects, and how the team measures and maximizes impact for the animals. We are looking for someone excited to build these structures. You will also work on hiring, managing incoming consulting projects, designing research processes, and managing staff. We want to create a team with a mix of cross-cutting skills, such as economics, policy, animal welfare ecosystem knowledge, stakeholder management, M&E, and animal science. We have 1–2 economist staff ready to join this team. This role will report to Sam Hilton, Acting Director of the Animal Welfare Department. Ideal start date: Monday 4th January 2027 Key Responsibilities You are responsible for leading the team's areas of work. This includes: Manage consulting intake . Decide which requests from funders, advocacy organizations, and entrepreneurs RP takes on, reshapes, or declines. Identify opportunities and act on them . Bring forward ideas with outsized upside, research or otherwise. For research, set an agenda of priority projects. For other interventions, such as regranting or talent programs, decide whether RP should run them and launch what clears the bar. Oversee the Animal Advocacy Strategy Forum . Ensure your team: sets the agenda, decides who is in the room, and turns the movement's annual leaders' gathering into decisions and impact. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: Set strategy. Decide how this team prioritizes, how it measures impact and what work it takes on. There is no project prioritization process, impact framework or intake system yet – you will build them alongside the Director. Hire . Decide which skills the team needs next: policy, M&E, animal science, movement experience. Run the rounds, supported by RP's in-house recruitment specialist. Manage the team . Lead economists and specialists with deeper expertise than yours in their own fields. Set the quality bar. Put in place research processes, review standards and project tracking. Deliver research that gets used . Scope clients' decisions, manage staff to deliver on deadline, and follow up on whether clients acted on the findings. Represent RP . Build the networks and relationships that generate new projects. Attend conferences where you are able to travel. Fundraise . With the Development Team's support, raise additional funds as the team grows. What We Are Looking For Essential criteria Impact first. Driven to have as much impact for animals as possible. Committed to integrity in research, to following the evidence, and to being transparent about what it shows. Decision-oriented research experience. Experience conducting or overseeing research aimed at informing or influencing a specific stakeholder's decision. Good judgment. Demonstrated judgment in prioritization and decision-making under uncertainty. Management experience. Experience managing or mentoring others, including people with deeper expertise than yours, or clear readiness to step into a people-management role. Strategy and process design. Experience of, or clear ability to set a team's strategy and build processes to deliver it where none existed. Research review skills. Ability to interrogate both qualitative and quantitative analysis you did not produce, and to "think at the margin" about cost-effectiveness. Communication skills. Excellent reasoning transparency: ability to show the assumptions and evidence behind your conclusions. Strong ability to synthesize complex information and communicate strategic insight in writing and in person. Delivery. Track record of getting projects finished, on deadline, involving other people. Works well and makes autonomous decisions in a remote, asynchronous, international environment. Desirable criteria Consulting experience. Consulting or other client-facing analytical work: identifying the decision a client is actually facing, shaping or declining work accordingly, and building relationships with clients and fundraising leads. Experience of the animal organizational landscape . Professional or voluntary experience of animal advocacy. A working knowledge of the organizational landscape, funders, and strategic debates. In-depth expertise in a relevant area. Such as economics, policy and regulation, M&E, or animal science. Events and convening experience. Running convenings or facilitating events that bring together groups with differing interests. Talent development experience. Running talent programs or fellowships. Grantmaking experience. Distributing funds and evaluating organizations for funding. We expect that even highly qualified applicants will not meet all of these criteria. We encourage you to apply even if you do not have some of these skills, knowledge and experiences. What We Offer Compensation We offer an annual salary within the following ranges for a full-time position, prorated for part-time work: $98,500 - $125,000 USD pre-tax £76,590 - £97,176 GBP pre-tax €89,459 - €113,527 EUR pre-tax Compensation is not restricted to the currencies listed above. The exact salary will be based on the candidate’s title level, and calculated using RP’s salary algorithm. Towards the upper end we would expect a track record of leading a research team to drive impact. Towards the lower end we would expect strong research judgment with a shorter management record, or management experience but weaker research skills. You do not need to say which end you think you fit; we assess this from your application. To ensure fairness across the entire organization, RP does not negotiate salaries. Other Benefits Opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, high-impact organization — our research is used by key decision-makers who influence the distribution of hundreds of millions of charitable dollars. Remote-first environment, including flexible work hours and schedule. Virtual co-working spaces, including a private Rethink Priorities Focusmate group Comprehensive global benefits program, including statutory benefits as required by local law, and supplemental benefits specific to each country (varies by location) Generous paid time off (PTO) and unpaid leave, including: Unlimited vacation with a minimum number of required statutory days off "Mandated" 3 weeks total mid- and end-year organization-wide breaks Unlimited (within reason) personal and sick paid and unpaid leave Parental leave — at least 4 - 9 months of a combination of paid and unpaid leave, available prior to and/or during the first 2 years after a child's birth or adoption Other paid and unpaid leave (e.g., bereavement) Technology stipend of $2,000 USD equivalent every 3 years for work and office equipment and an AI tools budget of $40 USD equivalent monthly Professional Development Budget of $4000 USD per year. Learning opportunities, including workshops/training sessions and up to 10% of work time dedicated to professional and personal development Paid work trips, including one annual all-staff Mega Team Retreat and relevant conferences A caring team that values respectful work relations and a healthy work-life balance. Low administrative bureaucracy. We don’t provide snacks, but we could mail you a box of Oreos if you want! Apply here Application deadline Mon 19th October , end of day (anywhere on earth). Please click the link on the sidebar / at the foot of this page to apply. Additional Information Role-Specific Work Environment and Visa Sponsorship: This role is fully remote and we are able to legally hire in many countries. In certain cases, we may be able to provide visa sponsorship to the US or UK and help candidates relocate. If you have questions about whether we can hire or provide visa sponsorship in another country and if this will influence your decision about applying, please contact before submitting your application. Time Zones and Working Hours: While we welcome applicants from all time zones, you will need to have some availability for meetings between 3pm and 5pm UK time on most weekdays, when our Europe-based and US Central time based colleagues overlap. Depending on where you are, this may mean early morning or evening calls. Full and Part Time Position: This role is open to full-time and part-time candidates who are available to work at least 24 hours per week. Candidates able to work at least 30 hours a week will be preferred. Travel: Travel is not an essential requirement for this position. Travel is not mandatory, but encouraged. A majority of our staff travel a few times per year for conferences, team and all-staff retreats, and other work-related purposes. If, for any reason, you would prefer not to travel for work, please do not be discouraged from applying. Depending on the event, we can likely make accommodations, such as allowing virtual participation when possible. Language: Professional level of English language is required for all roles at Rethink Priorities . Application process There are 4 evaluation stages. Only candidates who meet the minimum bar at a given stage will proceed to the next stage. We aim to complete assessments for each stage within a week, so you can quickly learn whether you will proceed to the next stage. Stage 1: Application Prompts We will score whether your responses to the prompts indicate: alignment with our mission ability to perform tasks that are common for the role relevant experience in similar roles Stage 2: Skills assessment You will complete a ~5-hour task that assesses core competencies for the role. You will be paid $45 USD per hour for completing this assessment Stage 3: Interviews We will ask you questions relevant to a variety of skills and experiences required for the role. Most of these questions will be sent in advance. In a few cases, we will tell you about the topic in advance, but not the specific question. You will have an opportunity to ask questions about the role, the Animal Welfare department, and RP more broadly. Stage 4: Reference checks and offers We will ask for two to three references about your job experiences. Hiring Process-Specific Anonymity : We initially assess on anonymized application prompts and test tasks. Please do not send a cover letter, and do not include your name in your responses to the longer application prompts. Extension requests: We will try to accommodate extension requests made before the deadline, up to 3 days. We generally cannot accommodate extension requests made after the application deadline, or that are longer than 3 days, and cannot accept late submissions to ensure fairness to other applicants. AI use in initial application: You may search for information online or use a free AI assistant (such as ChatGPT, free tier) to provide you with additional support in responding to the initial application questions. If you use an AI assistant, please disclose how you used it and how it changed your responses. Application materials: All application materials must be submitted in English language; otherwise, we will not be able to evaluate your candidacy. Inclusivity and fairness: RP is committed to building an inclusive, equitable, and supportive community for you to thrive and do your best work. Please don’t hesitate to apply for a role regardless of your age, gender identity/expression, political identity, personal preferences, physical abilities, veteran status, neurodiversity or any other background. We provide reasonable accommodations and benefits, including, for example, flexible work schedules and locations, mental health coverage through medical benefits (as available), as well as technology budgets and professional development time that can be used, for example, to purchase assistive technology or engage in job coaching. Accessibility: We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible hiring process. We warmly invite you to reach out to with any questions or accessibility requests such as chat box use during interviews. Hiring Software: We use Pinpoint for our recruitment and hiring processes and all of the email correspondence is done via Pinpoint. We encourage you to add Pinpoint domain (@pinpoint.email) to your trusted contacts and/or check your 'spam', 'promotions' and ‘updates’ folders, if you don’t hear from us within the expected timeframe. Past applicant policy: We may be able to accelerate your job application if you have applied to the same or similar role within RP or a similar institution and advanced within the last 2 years. Please get in touch stating which role you applied to, when, and to which stage you were advanced at which organization if you would like to be considered for this possibility. Consideration for other roles : We sometimes identify strong candidates in one hiring round whose skills are well matched to other senior roles within the department. If you are not selected for this position, we may contact you to ask whether you would like to be considered for a related senior opening, should one arise. You do not need to indicate interest at the application stage. Other: Visit our Career webpage if you’d like to know more about our hiring process, culture, and what working at RP is like. About Rethink Priorities Founded in 2018, Rethink Priorities (RP) is a think-and-do tank. Through research and action, the organization improves the lives of humans and animals—both now and in the future. We work to identify solutions, mobilize resources, and empower our team and others to address some of the world’s most pressing problems. Our team conducts rigorous research across animal welfare, climate change, global health, international development, and other important and neglected areas. Our operations experts help high-impact organizations to improve efficiency and achieve meaningful results. RP works as all of the following: A consultancy doing commissioned work in response to demands from organizations doing high-impact work A research institute driven by research agendas we set according to our own priorities. A think tank aiming to inform public policy to improve the world. An accelerator, incubator, and base for priority projects. Accomplishments include: Bringing attention to neglected issues, such as lead exposure, fungal diseases, and shrimp welfare. Increasing the collective impact of advocates across each field in which we work through strategic coordination. Investigating potential interventions and identifying the most cost-effective options. In 2025, our research influenced tens of millions of dollars in foundation grants. Creating practical tools for philanthropists to compare resource allocations across different species and cause areas and to build giving portfolios despite uncertainties. Providing organizations with data to inform their decisions. For example, we have conducted surveys on perceptions of existential risks, AI, effective giving, and other topics. Providing fiscal sponsorship and operational support to ensure that high-impact initiatives in areas like AI safety and animal welfare can launch and grow effectively. Donor Compass - Cross Cause Fund Tool to guide philanthropic giving We welcome you to review our research database and our latest annual report. Contact Contact: Please email if you have any questions. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: AI Researcher – Multilingual Data
items.summary: About the RoleWe’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains.
items.description: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains. You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Design and execute research on multilingual datasets , including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design) Research and improve cross-lingual transfer , alignment, and robustness in large language models Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate Translate research insights into practical improvements in production models What We’re Looking For Strong background in NLP / ML research , with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages Solid understanding of: Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.) Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment Nice to Have Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling Experience training or evaluating large language models Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA) Why Join Us Real ownership over research direction and impact A team that values papers and production Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Chief Operating Officer
items.summary: About Fòs FeministaFòs Feminista is a global intersectional feminist organization advancing the sexual and reproductive health and rights of women, girls, and gender-diverse people.
items.description: About Fòs Feminista Fòs Feminista is a global intersectional feminist organization advancing the sexual and reproductive health and rights of women, girls, and gender-diverse people. Led and governed by the Global South, Fòs Feminista works through a constellation of affiliated organizations, legal entities, strategic partnerships, and movement relationships with around 200 civil society partners across 40 countries. Our work integrates advocacy, grantmaking, research, movement-building, sexual and reproductive healthcare, and innovative finance to strengthen feminist organizations and movements worldwide. Operating across multiple jurisdictions and institutional structures, Fòs Feminista brings together legal, political, philanthropic, and movement strategies to advance gender justice and achieve lasting systemic change. Position overview Fòs Feminista is seeking a Chief Operating Officer to provide strategic and operational leadership across the organization. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer and serving on the Strategic Management Team (SMT), the COO will translate strategy into coordinated plans, sound resource decisions, effective institutional systems, and accountable implementation. The COO will integrate People, Inclusion, and Culture; Business Intelligence, Evaluation and Research; and Legal Affairs. The Chief Financial Officer will report to the COO for operational integration and fiduciary responsibilities while retaining a direct relationship with the CEO. The role requires a leader who can move between strategy and execution and work across functions, regions, and cultures. Position within the organization Reports to: Chief Executive Officer Leadership body: Strategic Management Team Direct and functional oversight: • People, Inclusion, and Culture Business Intelligence, Evaluation and Research • Legal Affairs • Chief Financial Officer, within the dual-reporting arrangement described above Principal responsibilities 1. Executive leadership and strategic execution • Serve as a strategic partner to the CEO and an active member of the SMT, contributing to the development, review, and implementation of organizational strategy. • Translate priorities into annual and multi-year plans that connect responsibilities, timelines, resources, and measures of progress. • Help SMT assess opportunities and challenges in relation to mission impact, finances, organizational capacity, risk, and effects on partners; monitor progress and address barriers. • Support organizational continuity, assume responsibilities delegated by the CEO, and represent Fòs Feminista with the Board, partners, donors, advisers, and other external actors as appropriate. 2. Organizational integration and performance • Act as a principal integrator across strategy, finance, people, evidence, legal affairs, resource mobilization, and operational capacity. • Strengthen cross-unit planning, clarify responsibilities and decision points, and ensure that organizational gaps and matters without a clear institutional owner are addressed. • Lead policy development, integrated systems implementation, the responsible use of AI, and major organizational change to improve efficiency and cost-effectiveness. 3. Financial stewardship and organizational sustainability • Provide executive oversight of financial planning and performance with the CFO and CEO, connecting budgets, forecasts, staffing, fundraising projections, program commitments, and organizational priorities. • Support budgets, financial scenarios, and resource-allocation recommendations; monitor performance, sustainability, and risks; and ensure that SMT receives timely analysis. • Ensure strong systems for financial controls, restricted funding, grants and contracts, audits, procurement, and compliance while protecting the CFO’s professional and fiduciary responsibilities, including direct access to the CEO and, where appropriate, the Board. 4. Connection with resource mobilization Align revenue strategies and major proposals with organizational priorities, delivery capacity, financial forecasts, commitments to partners, realistic costing, and risk analysis. • Strengthen coordination throughout the funding cycle; support governance and performance monitoring of the Feminist Impact Fund; and assess the funding portfolio’s effect on longer-term sustainability. • Join selected donor discussions when institutional, financial, or operational questions require executive participation. Fundraising strategy, donor cultivation, and revenue generation remain with Resource Mobilization and the CEO. 5. People, inclusion, and culture Provide strategic leadership to People, Inclusion, and Culture and ensure that recruitment, performance, compensation, development, succession, and staff well-being support the mission and strategy. • Strengthen management practice, organizational design, workforce planning, accountability, and team development while sustaining trust and collaboration. • Ensure that people practices reflect feminist values, equity and inclusion, and a distributed multilingual workforce, and that difficult matters can be addressed with clarity, fairness, and appropriate confidentiality. 6. Business intelligence, evidence, and organizational learning • Provide strategic oversight to Business Intelligence, Evaluation and Research; strengthen the use of data in planning and decisions; and ensure that reporting and indicators serve learning and accountability. • Ensure appropriate governance, protection, and ethical use of organizational and partner data. Oversee and integrate staff safety, digital and information security, AI risks, and crisis response. 7. Legal affairs, compliance, and risk Provide executive oversight of Legal Affairs and ensure that legal considerations enter organizational planning and decisions early. • Maintain an organization-wide approach to legal, financial, operational, safeguarding, security, data, reputational, and people-related risks, including appropriate controls, escalation, continuity arrangements, and responses to significant compliance matters. • Ensure that contractual, regulatory, and governance obligations across jurisdictions are understood and managed. • Protect the professional independence of Legal Affairs. Its head retains direct access to the CEO and, when required, the appropriate Board body, including for concerns involving any senior manager or the COO. Decision-making and authority The COO will exercise authority delegated by the CEO and established through organizational policies, approved plans, and governance responsibilities. Decisions with significant strategic, financial, legal, reputational, workforce, or partner implications will be brought to the CEO, SMT, or Board. The COO will support them with integrated analysis, clear options, and effective implementation. Leadership profile The successful candidate will be a senior organizational leader with the judgment, experience, and relational capacity to work across multiple functions and institutional contexts. They will combine strategic perspective with disciplined execution and lead through coordination, trust, and influence as well as formal reporting relationships. They will bring: Demonstrated experience in a senior executive or enterprise-wide role in a complex international nonprofit, philanthropic, social-impact, or other mission-driven organization. • Experience leading or integrating several functions, such as finance, people and culture, operations, legal or compliance, organizational data, strategy implementation, or business development. • Strong financial literacy and experience using budgets, forecasts, and analysis to guide decisions and connect strategy with measurable results. • Experience working across countries, cultures, legal environments, or distributed teams and building productive relationships with senior colleagues, boards, staff, partners, donors, and advisers. • Experience leading change, strengthening systems without unnecessary bureaucracy, supporting functional leaders, and fostering collective accountability, with excellent judgment in sensitive matters. • A clear commitment to feminist principles, sexual and reproductive health and rights, racial and gender justice, and leadership from the Global South. • An understanding of partnership-based organizations and systems responsive to partner priorities. Professional fluency in English is required; Spanish, Portuguese, or French is an asset. No single professional pathway is required. Candidates may come from operations, finance, organizational strategy, people and culture, international nonprofit management, philanthropy, social enterprise, or another relevant field, provided they demonstrate the breadth required for enterprise-level leadership. Personal and leadership qualities The COO should be: Strategically minded and attentive to implementation, able to move between organizational detail and long-term questions and create clarity in ambiguous situations. • Collaborative but prepared to make difficult decisions, hold colleagues accountable, respect their expertise, and listen across differences. • Transparent, reliable, calm under pressure, and committed to shared leadership, sound delegation, and collective governance. Indicators of success During the initial period, success in the role would include: Clearer integration among Finance; People, Inclusion, and Culture; Business Intelligence; Legal Affairs; Resource Mobilization; and other units. • Greater consistency among strategy, budgets, staffing, fundraising commitments, operational capacity, and organizational evidence. • Clear and trusted planning, follow-through, decision-making, and escalation processes, with stronger support for managers. • Effective management of institutional risk through systems that remain proportionate and responsive to partners. • A trusted working relationship among the CEO, COO, CFO, SMT, and Board, and a leadership culture combining accountability with feminist values. Location: This position is fully remote. Compensation: Fòs Feminista offers generous compensation consistent with competitive salaries and a benefits package that includes private health coverage, life insurance, retirement benefits, paid sick, vacation leave and parental leave, holidays, and flexible working arrangements. The annual salary is up to USD up to $220,000. Safeguarding Commitments Fòs Feminista is committed to ensuring that the health, rights and wellbeing of all children, young people, and vulnerable populations who work and engage with Fòs Feminista ’s Team Members and Associated Persons are respected and protected in their interactions with them and requires all its Team Members and Associated Persons to share this commitment. The successful candidate must: • Demonstrate an understanding of and commitment to safeguarding in the United States and the international context. • Sign and adhere to Fòs Feminista ’s International Safeguarding Policy and Safeguarding Code of Conduct, including the minimum operating standards for protection from sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA). Equal Opportunity Employer Statement Fòs Feminista is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to advancing sexual and reproductive rights and health and dismantling inequities from a feminist intersectional lens. Reproductive justice, racial justice, and diversity are driving forces for us. Fòs Feminista provides equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to age, race, color, disability, national origin, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital and partnership status, genetic information, veteran status or any other protected category under federal, state and local law. At Fòs Feminista , we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices and experiences of our employees. We strongly encourage applications from all kinds of backgrounds to build a diverse workforce in which all social and minority groups are represented. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
items.summary: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. items.title: Freelance Copywriter
items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric. Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate Application Process Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process. Basic Requirements • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English • Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States • Active use of Gmail and social media platforms • Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection • Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher) • Access to a personal computer Assessment You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

items.title: AI Response Evaluator
items.location: France, Japan, Turkey, Vietnam, Mexico, Norway
items.summary: iMerit is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing. Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match. What you will do Interpret conversational context and identify what the user really wanted Rate and rank responses against defined quality criteria Compare multiple answers and explain in writing why one wins Verify factual claims using approved research sources Flag tasks that cannot be reliably assessed rather than guessing What you bring: Strong critical thinking and sound judgment in ambiguous cases Solid research skills and attention to detail Excellent reading comprehension Self direction and the discipline to hit deadlines without supervision Good to know Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project. Fully remote and flexible. You choose your hours as long as volume and deadlines are met. Task volume varies with project demand.

items.summary: About the role The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company. About Arabian Private Holdings Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets. What you will do Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment. Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations. Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies. Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals. Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates. Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized. Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews. Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports. What we are looking for A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving. Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors. Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English. Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors. Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review. A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics. How we work We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients. What the role offers A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market. Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates. Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region. The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote. Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health. Please mention the word **TRIVIALLY** and tag RMTI4LjIwMy4xOTkuMTQ1 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTI4LjIwMy4xOTkuMTQ1). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role: As a founding Strategic Sales Director for Iberia, you will own 8-12 of the largest strategic accounts across Spain and/or Portugal — IBEX35-caliber banking, telco, insurance, utilities, and travel enterprises. You'll run complex, multi-level sales cycles from 6 to 18 months, build both the business case and the technical win alongside your Solutions Consultant, and drive long-term land-and-expand strategy while continuing to bring in new logos. As part of the founding Iberia team, you'll work alongside a 10-person Madrid-based org (SDR, SC, and Customer Success) and help shape the region's go-to-market strategy from the ground up. Responsibilities: Manage a portfolio of 8-12 top strategic accounts in Spain and/or Portugal Generate your own pipeline — Cresta drives strong inbound, but Strategic AEs are expected to self-source roughly 50% of pipeline Orchestrate complex, multi-level sales cycles (6-18 months) across buying committees, procurement, legal, and security Build the business case and the technical win in partnership with your Solutions Consultant and extended team Drive land-and-expand strategy with a long-term vision for each account, while continuing to prioritize new-logo acquisition Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience Qualifications We Value: 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, including at least 4 years as a quota-carrying individual contributor selling into large Spanish enterprises (IBEX35 or equivalent: banking, telco, insurance, utilities, travel) Verified track record closing deals of €500K+ ARR / €1M+ TCV, including at least one deal exceeding €1M TCV at an IBEX35-caliber account New-logo hunting as your primary motion — majority of attainment historically from net-new logos rather than installed-base expansion Experience navigating complex 6-18 month cycles, including RFPs, buying committees, and procurement/legal/security review in regulated industries Existing C-level/VP network within Spanish enterprise accounts Nice-to-Have: CX / contact center / conversational AI domain exposure (CCaaS, WEM, analytics, virtual agents) Experience opening a market or territory from zero for a hyper-growth vendor Experience co-selling with SIs and channel partners (e.g. Accenture, Telefónica Tech, Sabio-type ecosystem) Familiarity with Ley SAC and Spanish regulatory drivers in customer service MEDDPICC (or equivalent) formally trained Language & Travel: Native or negotiation-grade Spanish, fluent English; Portuguese is a strong plus Madrid-based, with travel across the Iberian Peninsula expected Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced Compensation at Cresta Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed. OTE Range: TBD (comp benchmarking in progress) + Offers Equity We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

items.description: We are currently seeking a Legal Consultant - Asset Management / Securities to join our team and support our financial insitution clients. Responsibilities Provide legal support on asset management, securities brokerage, and wealth management activities across region Draft, review, and negotiate key documentation, including fund constitutive documents, investment management and distribution agreements, and brokerage/trading agreements (e.g., ISDA, futures, and options). Review client‑facing and marketing materials for funds, portfolios, and wealth management products, ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Monitor regulatory developments, update internal policies/templates, and deliver training to business and support teams on securities and asset management legal issues. Requirements (3 bullets) 1-4 years of post‑qualification experience, expeirenced in securities, funds, or asset management law at a reputable law firm or financial institution. Excellent contract drafting and communication skills in English and Chinese, ideally including Mandarin proficiency Compensation, Benefits & Working Location: This role offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package in the alternative legal services marketplace, that includes health benefits, CPF/MPF contributions and more. Axiomites also get access to professional development resources and learning and development programs. Axiom provides the opportunity to work remotely, onsite or hybrid, depending on client requirements. Axiom is the global leader in high-calibre, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in breed alterative legal services. Axiom is a leader in diversity, inclusion, and social engagement. Diversity is core to our values and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be named a best place to work for LGBTQ+ Equality, earning top marks in the 2021 Corporate Equality Index for the second consecutive year. Axiom’s legal department is Mansfield certified and is committed to considering at least 50% diverse candidates for leadership roles and outside counsel representation. Learn more about life at Axiom . World-class clients – our global presence provides direct access to opportunities with leading companies, including F100 organizations, allowing you to roadmap your career with exciting and challenging work. Flexibility – we work with you to achieve the highest level of flexibility – in the way that you define it. Whether you prefer remote work, a greater breadth of exposure, or even more personal time – we present you with opportunities that help you reach these goals. items.title: Mapping and Analysis of Family Language in African Union Agreed Language and Hum
items.summary: 1. BackgroundFòs Feminista. Fòs Feminista is an International Alliance of more than 200 partners across 40 countries working on the sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice (SRHRJ) of women, girls, and gender-diverse people.
items.description: 1. Background Fòs Feminista . Fòs Feminista is an International Alliance of more than 200 partners across 40 countries working on the sexual and reproductive health, rights, and justice (SRHRJ) of women, girls, and gender-diverse people. In 2026, Fòs Feminista completed a three-decade mapping of how "family" has been used in United Nations agreed language — reviewing 1,441 excerpts across 180 UN documents from 1994 to 2025. That mapping found that a substantial, underused body of UN agreed language already centers individual rights, gender equality, and diverse family forms, offering feminist advocates a propositional foundation to build on rather than only a defensive posture against anti-rights mobilization around "family." This mapping has not yet been extended to the regional level. The African Union (AU) has its own distinct body of human rights instruments, agreed language, and political dynamics relevant to family, gender equality, and SRHR — including the Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (the Maputo Protocol), one of the most progressive regional instruments globally on women’s rights, alongside AU mechanisms with an active record on ending child marriage and other harmful practices. At the same time, the AU is not insulated from anti-rights and anti-gender actors seeking to co-opt family language in multilateral outcomes. As such, Fòs Feminista is seeking a consultant to conduct a systematic mapping and analysis of family-related language across African Union agreed language and human rights mechanisms to produce a rigorous, regionally grounded evidence base for use in African Union-level advocacy. 2. Purpose and Objectives The purpose of this consultancy is to produce a systematic, evidence-based mapping of how "family" is defined, referenced, and used across African Union agreed language, in order to: Identify where existing AU agreed language already reflects rights-based, gender-equal, and diverse understandings of family, distinguishing this from areas where family language is used restrictively or left unaddressed. Produce a citable evidence base to inform feminist advocacy in African Union-level negotiations. Identify patterns specific to the African regional context — including but not limited to child marriage, female genital mutilation and other harmful practices, inheritance and marital property rights, and care — grounded in the region’s own instruments and mechanisms. Analyze whether language has changed over time, assessing whether it reflects advancement, regression, or stagnation in relation to gender equality and SRHR, and identifying the instruments, sessions or political context associated with such shifts. Generate concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language proposals for use in AU Summit declarations, Specialized Technical Committee outcomes, and other AU negotiating processes. 3. Scope of Work The consultant will review family-related language across the following African Union instruments and mechanisms, at minimum: The African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights (1981) and its jurisprudence. The Protocol to the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights on the Rights of Women in Africa (Maputo Protocol, 2003), with particular attention to its marriage, family, and inheritance provisions. The African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (1990). Decisions, declarations, and resolutions of the AU Assembly of Heads of State and Government and the Executive Council. Resolutions, General Comments, and Concluding Observations of the African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights (ACHPR). General Comments and Concluding Observations of the African Committee of Experts on the Rights and Welfare of the Child (ACERWC). The Solemn Declaration on Gender Equality in Africa (2004) and subsequent AU gender policy instruments. The Plan of Action on the Family in Africa (2004), adopted by the AU Assembly to mark the tenth anniversary of the International Year of the Family, and its 2010 mid-term review. The Continental Policy Framework on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (2005, endorsed by the AU Assembly in January 2006) and the Maputo Plan of Action for its operationalization, including subsequent iterations (2007–2010 and the revised 2016–2030 Plan). Outcome documents of relevant AU Specialized Technical Committees, including those on Health, Population and Drug Control; Gender Equality and Women’s Empowerment; and Social Development, Labour and Employment. Materials and declarations associated with the AU Campaign to End Child Marriage. Agenda 2063 and associated flagship programmes, where family-related language appears. The consultant, in consultation with Fòs Feminista , will propose a final document list and inclusion timeframe during the inception phase (see Section 5). 4. Specific Tasks Review Fòs Feminista ’s existing mapping and adapt methodology to the African Union context, in consultation with Fòs Feminista . Define inclusion criteria, search terms, and a document timeframe appropriate to AU instruments, accounting for the African Union’s founding in 2002 and, where relevant, continuity with instruments of its predecessor, the Organisation of African Unity (OAU). Systematically identify and retrieve relevant documents across the proposed mechanisms. Extract all excerpts referencing family (and relevant equivalent terminology across the AU’s working languages, as feasible) into a structured, coded database. Code excerpts thematically, drawing on categories established in the UN-level mapping, while remaining open to additional categories specific to the African regional context. Assess the political and normative implications of each excerpt (positive, neutral, or negative) from a feminist, rights-based perspective, consistent with the coding logic used in the UN-level mapping. Analyze how family-related language has evolved over the mapping period, identifying patterns of advancement, regression, or stagnation in relation to gender equality and SRHR, and the specific instruments, sessions, or political context associated with such shifts. Draft a mapping report presenting findings, methodology, illustrative excerpts with full citations, and the trend analysis described above. Generate concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language formulations suited to AU negotiating contexts, grounded in specific cited instances of existing agreed language. Provide updates and present final findings to Fòs Feminista and relevant partners. 5. Deliverables Inception report, including proposed methodology, document list, inclusion criteria, and timeframe (due at the end of the inception phase). A structured spreadsheet database of coded excerpts, consistent in format with Fòs Feminista ’s existing UN-level mapping database (mechanism, document title, citation/symbol, date, page reference, excerpt text, and thematic codes). A draft mapping and analysis report, for Fòs Feminista review and feedback. This should already include a set of concrete recommendations and draft rights-based language proposals for AU negotiating contexts, cross-referenced to specific cited excerpts. A final mapping and analysis report incorporating feedback, including an executive summary suitable for external advocacy use. A presentation of findings (virtual or in-person, to be agreed) to Fòs Feminista and partner organizations. 6. Indicative Timeline The following is an indicative timeline of approximately 10 weeks; the final schedule will be confirmed with the selected consultant during contracting. Weeks 1–2: Inception phase — methodology, document list, and workplan finalized. Weeks 3–4: Document identification, retrieval, and excerpt extraction. Weeks 4–6: Thematic coding and analysis. Weeks 6–8: Draft mapping report submitted to and reviewed by Fòs Feminista . Weeks 8–10: Revisions, finalization, and presentation of findings. 7. Required Qualifications and Experience Advanced degree (Master’s or higher) in law, human rights, gender studies, African studies, political science, or a related field. Demonstrated knowledge of African Union human rights mechanisms and regional legal and policy frameworks, including the Maputo Protocol. Prior experience conducting legal, policy, or content analysis of agreed language, treaty text, or comparable normative documents. Experience applying feminist or rights-based analytical frameworks to legal and policy texts. Strong written communication skills in English; working proficiency in French, Arabic, and/or Portuguese is highly desirable given the African Union’s official languages. Prior experience on gender equality, SRHR, or family law in the African regional context is strongly preferred. Familiarity with qualitative data analysis tools (e.g., Dedoose, NVivo, or comparable software) is an asset. 8. Reporting and Supervision The consultant will report to an assigned Senior Advocacy Officer and will maintain regular check-ins (proposed bi-weekly, to be confirmed) throughout the assignment to review progress against the agreed workplan. 9. Application Process Interested candidates should submit the following by October 16, 2026: A current CV or resume. A cover letter outlining relevant experience and interest in the assignment. A brief proposed methodology and workplan (no more than 3 pages), including any suggested adaptations to the approach described above. A financial proposal, inclusive of a proposed daily or total consultancy rate. A relevant writing sample (e.g., a legal or policy analysis, research report, or comparable output). 10. Budget The total consultancy fee for this assignment is USD 6,000–7,000, inclusive of all costs. Candidates should submit a proposed budget within this range as part of their application; Fòs Feminista will confirm the final consultancy fee during contracting. Originally posted on Himalayas

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ The Content Coordinator manages content assets and client communication throughout the production process, keeping projects organized and moving from initial intake through final delivery. Working within our existing AirOps workflows, this role serves as a central point of contact between clients, our editor, our stock image vendor, and the Content Production Manager. This is a coordination-focused role that combines clear communication, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through. The Content Coordinator ensures that each contributor has the information and assets they need, tracks outstanding tasks and approvals, and flags issues that could affect production timelines. Key responsibilities Coordinate content projects across each stage of production, following established AirOps workflows and internal processes. Collect, organize, and maintain client briefs, source materials, drafts, images, feedback, and final deliverables. Communicate with clients to request missing information, share status updates, clarify feedback, and follow up on approvals. Coordinate handoffs between clients, the editor, the stock image vendor, and the Content Production Manager. Track project status, deadlines, dependencies, and outstanding requests, keeping production records accurate and current. Consolidate client feedback into clear, actionable instructions for the editor and other production contributors. Coordinate stock image requests and delivery, ensuring that selected assets align with the content brief and client requirements. Check that required assets, revisions, and approvals are complete before moving content to the next production stage. Flag delays, unclear requests, missing materials, or scope changes to the Content Production Manager. Prepare and organize final content assets for delivery, ensuring that files are clearly labeled and the correct versions are shared. Identify recurring coordination issues and suggest practical improvements to documentation, communication, and workflow execution. Qualifications and skills Experience in content coordination, marketing operations, project coordination, or a similar client-facing support role. Strong written communication skills and the ability to provide clear, professional updates to clients and internal contributors. Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and follow-ups. Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing content versions, feedback, and production assets. Comfort working within established workflows and learning tools such as AirOps. Ability to distinguish routine coordination needs from issues that require escalation. A proactive, dependable approach to keeping projects moving and closing communication gaps. Experience working with B2B SaaS clients. What success looks like Content projects move through production with timely handoffs and clearly documented next steps. Clients receive consistent updates and understand what is needed from them. Editors and vendors receive complete materials and actionable instructions. Content assets, feedback, and approvals remain organized and easy to locate. The Content Production Manager has reliable visibility into progress, blockers, and upcoming deadlines. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/simpletiger-content-coordinator-u-s-based-remote-contractor

items.description: Company Description About us: Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital. Today technology is driving the world. And at METRO.digital we are driving the technology for one of the leading international wholesalers specializing in food - METRO. From e-commerce to checkout, to delivery software, we work on a wide range of products to make each day a success for our customers and colleagues. With passion and ownership, we build the future of wholesale. You are driving to create smart solutions for customers around the globe? You want to grow in a flexible environment? Let the right career opportunity find you and join us! How you will make an impact? As a Procurement Consultant , you will manage strategic procurement activities for IT products and services. You will advise internal stakeholders, lead competitive sourcing processes and negotiate commercially attractive and sustainable agreements. Acting as the interface between our internal teams and external suppliers, you will help translate business and technology requirements into effective sourcing strategies. You will also contribute to supplier performance, category initiatives and the continuous development of our procurement approach. Job Description Your Responsibilities: Manage procurement activities for IT products and services from initial demand through supplier selection, negotiation and contracting; Advise and support internal stakeholders in developing the appropriate sourcing and procurement approach; Prepare, lead and execute RFIs, RFPs and other competitive sourcing processes; Lead commercial negotiations with suppliers, considering price, quality, risk, flexibility and long-term business value; Analyze supplier proposals and create transparent commercial evaluations and management recommendations; Act as a key interface between internal stakeholders, Legal, Finance, Security and external suppliers; Support contract development and ensure that commercial requirements, responsibilities and deliverables are clearly defined; Manage supplier relationships and contribute to structured governance, performance reviews and continuous improvement; Identify opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership, consolidate demand and optimise the supplier portfolio; Contribute to category strategies, market analyses and procurement initiatives; Support procurement-related projects and continuously improve sourcing processes, templates and ways of working; Manage several procurement activities in parallel while ensuring quality, transparency and timely delivery. Qualifications Required key competencies and qualifications: Several years of professional experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management or a comparable commercial role; Solid understanding of IT procurement, including software, cloud, professional services, managed services or other IT-related categories; Experience in leading sourcing processes and commercial negotiations with national and international suppliers; Good understanding of commercial and contractual models, such as fixed-price, time-and-materials, subscription, managed-service and outcome-based arrangements; Ability to analyse complex offers and translate commercial information into clear recommendations; Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to build credibility across different functions and seniority levels; Confidence in challenging requirements and supplier proposals constructively; A proactive, structured and results-oriented working style; Ability to work independently, prioritise a varied workload and meet agreed deadlines; Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills; A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute to the further development of the procurement organisation; Fluent English, both written and spoken. German would be an advantage. What success looks like in this role: Internal stakeholders receive pragmatic, reliable and commercially sound procurement advice; Sourcing activities are executed transparently, efficiently and in line with business requirements; Negotiations deliver measurable commercial value while maintaining sustainable supplier relationships; Commercial, contractual and supplier risks are identified early and addressed appropriately; Procurement is recognized as a strategic partner that enables business outcomes rather than only processing transactions. Additional Information What we offer at METRO.digital? Hybrid and agile work: thrive in a flexible, multicultural environment. At METRO.digital, we promote work-life balance through a hybrid working model. You’ll be part of self-organizing, multicultural teams that collaborate in an agile setup. Focused among other on development, leadership, appreciation … it´s time to upskill your career. Support with individual solutions: we are people-caring! We offer support whenever you need it - at every stage of your professional journey. Want to know more about all our benefits? Discover more here. Let´s connect soon. Apply for the role now! Position grade within our career framework: Procurement Consultant - PRC3 (Md7).
