items.description: Company Description Givebutter is the most-loved nonprofit fundraising and CRM platform, empowering millions of changemakers to raise more, pay less, and give better. Nonprofits use Givebutter to replace multiple tools so they can launch fundraisers and events, use donation forms and donor management (CRM), send emails and text blasts—all in one place. Use of the Givebutter platform is completely free with a 100% transparent tip-or-fee model. Givebutter has been certified as a Great Place to Work® every year since 2021, and is the #1 rated nonprofit software company on G2 across multiple categories. Our mission is to empower the changemaker in all of us. We believe giving should be fun, so you’ll want to do it again, and we also believe that work should be fun, so that you’ll have the greatest impact. We are excited to hear from talented people who want to work with other talented people in making the world a butter place—and have fun along the way. Role Description Givebutter is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our Treasury pod. You'll be directly responsible for delivering world-class financial infrastructure to our nonprofit users, maturing our engineering practices, and growing a team of skilled engineers. Engineering Managers at Givebutter are hands-on. You'll ship code, review PRs, make architectural decisions from a place of actual context, and stay close to production - monitoring systems, jumping into incidents, and understanding how your team's work actually behaves in the wild. We don't expect you to carry IC load like a senior engineer, but we do expect you to be in the editor regularly, pair when it helps the team, and prototype your way through ambiguity. If you've been fully out of the code for years and want to stay there, this probably isn't the right fit. The managers who thrive here earn trust on both the people side and the technical side. You'll report directly to our VP of Engineering and carry out our product vision while building a scalable engineering culture that breeds innovation. You'll make sure we ship excellent user experiences on time without compromising on security, design, or performance. You'll cultivate a team of high performers by removing roadblocks, building processes that incentivize excellence, and bringing real expertise in fintech and financial systems. We've already built a strong foundation, powering hundreds of millions of donations to over 40k organizations, and you'll take that impact much further. Why join Givebutter's Engineering team? Code Democracy – Every engineer has a voice. We value diverse perspectives and foster an environment for open discussion on architecture and technical ideas. Autonomy & Focus – Our engineers enjoy flexibility with minimal meetings and uninterrupted time to dive deep into problem-solving. Seamless CI/CD – Our deployment pipelines are fully automated, enabling engineers to focus on creating impactful code rather than managing deployments. Mission-Driven Work – You’ll be part of a team that supports nonprofits, charities, and organizations making a real difference around the world. What You’ll Bring to the Team An execution mindset with a strong bias toward delivering and iterating A product-oriented approach with a keen eye for consistency and user impact A passion for leadership and the ability to scale engineering practices in a high-growth environment Experience building financial products and a deep understanding of money movement, compliance, and financial infrastructure Responsibilities Collaborate with the VP of Engineering to develop and execute the Treasury engineering strategy Lead, manage, and mentor a talented team of full-stack engineers building Givebutter Wallet features, payment tools, and financial dashboards Own the Treasury engineering function, setting technical direction and ensuring alignment with company objectives Drive the development of same-day ACH transfer tools, card issuing systems, and QuickBooks integration that help nonprofits move money faster Build and maintain financial infrastructure that enables nonprofits to earn rewards on their funds and put money to work faster Bring technical expertise to the evolution of Givebutter's financial systems; ensure architecture and stack are optimized for security, reliability, and growth Improve internal engineering workflows, continually refining best practices Champion code quality across the team and uphold a high standard for maintainable and scalable solutions Evaluate and apply AI and machine learning tools to drive innovation in financial product development Requirements 7+ years of experience in full-stack development with expertise in modern web technologies (e.g., React, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP/Laravel) Hands-on experience designing and building scalable financial or fintech systems, ideally including payment processing, ACH, card issuing, or accounting integrations At least 2+ years of experience managing a team of 5+ engineers Strong understanding of financial compliance, security requirements, and data integrity in regulated environments Proven experience in people management, mentorship, and clear communication Demonstrated success in hiring and developing remote engineering teams Experience in a product-led growth environment is a strong plus More about Givebutter Benefits Remote Work: Work remotely from one of our 10 hubs (Austin, Denver, Indianapolis, Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Salt Lake City, Minneapolis, Seattle, and Nashville). Health Insurance: We offer Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance covered 100% for employees as well as HSA and FSA accounts. Dependent Care Coverage: We offer coverage for dependents, with 50% of Medical, Dental, and Vision premiums covered for all eligible dependents. Mental Health: Givebutter health insurance plans come with access to a TalkSpace membership. 401k: We offer a 3% 401k match for all eligible employee's. Vacation and Holidays: Givebutter offers a Flexible PTO policy with uncapped vacation days and company-recognized holidays. Wellness Week: Givebutter closes for one week each summer to prioritize rest and recharge for the entire team. Parental Leave: We offer 12 weeks of paid leave for all parents and comprehensive leave planning management through Aidora. Family Care Support: Access a company-paid UrbanSitter membership plus care credits to book trusted, background-checked caregivers for childcare, senior care, pet care, and household support when you need it most. Home Office Stipend: Upgrade your home office with company-sponsored expenses, including high-quality laptops, monitors, and modern technology. Coworking Stipend: Enjoy a monthly stipend that gives you the freedom to work from coworking spaces or cafés whenever you need connection, community, or a change of scenery. Charitable Giving: Employees are encouraged to donate up to $50/month to any verified nonprofit they wish to support on Givebutter. Professional Development: We offer learning and development reimbursement opportunities. Love What You Do: We are a mission-driven company serving the charitable sector. Feel good about the work you're doing and the company you work for. Interview Process Below is a high-level outline of our standard interview process Recruiter Screen: A 30-minute conversation to learn more about your background, walk through the role, and ensure mutual alignment on expectations, values, and logistics. Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper dive into your relevant experience, skillset, and working style. This is your first opportunity to connect directly with the person who may be your future manager. Assessment (technical or non-technical): This stage will vary based on the role. It could involve a live coding session, case study, or take-home project. Some roles may include two parts to this stage to evaluate both practical skills and problem-solving approaches Values Interview: A conversation with team members focused on how you align with our core values and leadership principles. References: We connect with a few folks you’ve worked closely with to get a better picture of your working style and impact. Offer: If all goes well, we’ll move to the offer stage! Please note, we will have an AI note-taking tool join most of our interviews. Hi potential new butterslice! A recent study from LinkedIn showed that most women apply to jobs only when they meet 100% of the requirements, whereas men will hit the apply button if they hit 60%. Givebutter is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. So to the women and nonbinary folks out there feeling unsure if you're a perfect fit, we strongly encourage you to apply!

items.description: Job Title Project Monitoring Officer Location Global Position Type Paid - Regular Job Description The Project Monitoring Officer plays a critical role in supporting SIL's expanding Resource Development strategy by ensuring the effective coordination, monitoring, and reporting of projects that support organizational and staff fundraising efforts. As SIL continues to grow its network of donors, grantors, and funding partners, this position serves as a central hub for collecting and managing project information, facilitating collaboration across departments, and ensuring that project proposals and reports meet the highest standards of quality, accuracy, and donor compliance. This globally focused role is responsible for overseeing the systematic collection, analysis, tracking, and reporting of project data to support grant management, fundraising initiatives, and strategic decision-making. The Project Monitoring Officer works closely with project leaders, fundraisers, and organizational stakeholders to develop compelling proposals, monitor project progress, measure outcomes, and provide timely reporting that strengthens donor relationships and demonstrates impact. Additionally, the position serves as a key liaison between SIL and ETEN Alliance, fostering strong partnership engagement, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, and ensuring alignment of shared goals and reporting requirements. The ideal candidate is highly organized, analytical, relationship-oriented, and motivated by supporting successful fundraising outcomes that enable SIL to advance its mission and expand its global impact. Responsibilities Project Intake, Proposal Development, and Stakeholder Coordination Serve as the primary point of contact for Areas, SCOs, and project leaders regarding project intake, proposal development, and reporting requirements. Manage project intake processes to ensure submitted projects have appropriate leadership endorsement, align with organizational priorities, demonstrate funding potential, and support measurable outcomes. Review and strengthen project concept notes, project descriptions, impact statements, and budgets to meet donor and funding partner expectations. Coordinate with project leaders and stakeholders to gather information necessary for proposal development and donor communications. Facilitate ongoing communication regarding project expectations, reporting requirements, accountability measures, and funding opportunities. Collaborate with internal departments to collect project stories, impact narratives, testimonials, and related content for donor reports, annual reports, websites, email campaigns, and stewardship communications. Project Registry and Reporting Management Maintain a comprehensive project registry and filing system that serves as the central repository for project information, proposals, reports, donor requirements, and related documentation. Manage project tracking systems, including funding coordination, proposal status, reporting schedules, and project documentation. Maintain reporting calendars and proactively communicate reporting deadlines to project leaders and funding recipients. Coordinate the collection, review, and submission of financial and narrative reports in accordance with donor agreements and organizational requirements. Support the development, formatting, editing, and distribution of project proposals and progress reports using approved organizational templates and standards. Ensure project files remain current, organized, and accessible to authorized stakeholders. Track donor requirements, reporting obligations, giving page support needs, and process improvements to enhance operational effectiveness. Funding Administration Support Coordinate project-related donation processing activities with gift administration and finance teams. Support accurate allocation of project funding, indirect cost recovery, and funding transfers. Maintain project funding records and update project tracking systems accordingly. Communicate project awards, funding decisions, reporting expectations, and compliance requirements to project recipients. Monitor project financial activity to support accurate reporting and donor accountability. Alliance Partnership Management Serve as a primary liaison between related partners. Maintain regular communication and engagement processes that support strong partner relationships and coordinated action. Represent SIL priorities, constraints, and outcomes in partnership discussions while ensuring partner expectations are clearly communicated internally. Establish and maintain systems to track funded activities, grant commitments, deliverables, and reporting obligations. Curate, validate, manage, and analyze project and operational data associated with funded activities. Generate reports, dashboards, and data insights to support grant reporting, organizational learning, performance evaluation, and strategic decision-making. Facilitate proposal development, grant reporting, project implementation tracking, and compliance monitoring across multiple departments and partner organizations. Ensure partnership commitments, deliverables, and reporting requirements are completed accurately and on schedule. Skills and Abilities Strong project coordination and project management capabilities while managing multiple priorities Excellent organizational, planning, and deadline-management skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders across multiple countries, cultures, and departments. Proficiency in preparing, editing, formatting, and reviewing proposals, reports, and project documentation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Competence in data collection, tracking, reporting, and analysis. Demonstrated initiative, follow-through, and commitment to continuous improvement. Education Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Nonprofit Management or related field preferred Travel Requirements Occasional domestic and international travel may be required, including attendance at approved in-person meetings, training events, and partner engagements. Weekly Hours 40 Originally posted on Himalayas

Fast-forward to today, and we've transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landsc
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Macedonia / Georgia / Moldova / Romania / Greece / Croatia / Kosovo / Serbia URL: http://belkins.io In 2017, Belkins started as an appointment-setting agency with just one service offering. Fast-forward to today, and we've transformed into Belkins Group — a vibrant ecosystem of services and products that define the cutting-edge landscape of the SalesTech and MarTech industries. For seven years running, we’ve been the top appointment-setting agency, achieving amazing results across 50+ industries worldwide. Our results speak for themselves: with over 1,000 clients and a global portfolio, we’ve set up more than 200,000 appointments, delivering a $10 return for every $1 spent. We’re experts in B2B appointment setting, providing essential services for companies ready to take their growth to the next level. By diving deep into lead research and using customized, omnichannel strategies, we turn opportunities into real success. Joining Belkins means signing up for a journey of unstoppable growth and success, driven by curiosity, dedication, and a commitment to excellence. We are looking for a results-driven SDR to join our intake pod - the team that runs new clients through their first three months at Belkins. Each pod is built around an Account Strategist who owns client strategy through the pilot, supported by a Delivery Lead, Content Strategist, Researcher, and Email Deliverability Specialist. This structure means the technical side of outreach is handled for you - your focus is on calling and converting prospect responses into booked appointments. You will work across multiple pilot-stage client projects at once (typically 3-4), running high-volume cold calling via power dialer and personally managing all replies from automated email and LinkedIn campaigns. Because every account is brand new, the meetings you book in the first weeks carry extra weight - they're often a client's first real proof that the engagement is working. Things You’ll Be Doing: Cold Calling Running outbound calling campaigns via power dialer (Koncert) across multiple (3-4) pilot-stage client projects at once - every account brand-new, so there's no history to lean on and no slow ramp-up; Handling objections live, on the call, and steering each conversation toward a booked appointment, not just working through a script; Tracking connect rate and call-to-meeting conversion, flagging performance issues to your Account Strategist before they become a pattern - with only three months on the clock, a slow week can't go unnoticed. Reply Handling — Email & LinkedIn Personally owning every reply that comes in from automated email (Reply.io / Inbox AI) and LinkedIn (Expandi) campaigns -responding within 4–8 working hours, handling objections in writing, and nurturing prospects until they convert into confirmed meetings; Scheduling appointments and sharing meeting details with the team via Slack. Campaign Oversight & Reporting Monitoring key metrics across every project - connect rate, reply rate, conversion rate - as your own numbers, not someone else's dashboard. Feeding structured feedback to Research, Content, and EDS so lead quality and messaging actually improve, not just flagging that something isn't working. Keeping CRM hygiene tight in HubSpot and sharing a weekly recap your Account Strategist can actually use. What You Bring: 2+ years of outbound SDR experience with a strong cold calling background ; Fluent English - written and spoken - comfortable working across US and European time zones; Metrics-driven: you track your dials, connect rates, and conversion numbers and know how to improve them; Strong objection handling and a consistent track record of landing next steps; Comfortable working brand-new accounts with no track record yet, and able to manage multiple pilot-stage client projects in parallel without losing quality or pace; Reliable CRM hygiene and disciplined follow-up across all open threads; Self-starting and proactive - you hold your pace without needing external pressure. How We Hire: Recruiter Interview (~30 minutes) — with Yuliia or Inna. Practical Task (~60–90 minutes) — a written exercise covering outbound thinking, objection handling, and lead prioritization. Hiring Manager Interview (~45–60 minutes) — a conversation with the SDR Enablement Manager covering the details of your work, performance analytics, and a live cold-call roleplay. Final Interview (~60 minutes) — with the Managing Director and HR Business Partner to assess company fit and explore your values and working style. Offer & Onboarding — if it's a yes, we move fast. *We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process. Final decisions are made by humans. Contact us for information on data processing. At Belkins, we care deeply about our team members, and we prove it through: Competitive Pay: Your dedication deserves more than recognition; it deserves compensation that matches your expertise. Remote-First Flexibility: We’ve transitioned to a fully remote environment so you can work where you're most productive. Our flexible hours help you stay agile and focused. Professional Growth: We’re a launchpad for your career. Through regular feedback, 1:1s, internal mobility, and knowledge-sharing, your growth is enabled and celebrated. We also maintain an internal wiki for insights and a library of the latest business books to keep you sharp. Well-being focus: Your mental health is a priority. We offer mental health lectures and support for your overall well-being. Recharge Time: We prioritize your rest with 20 paid vacation days, parental leave, fully covered sick days, and unlimited days off for unexpected needs. Global Sync: We align with U.S. holidays to keep our global teams in sync. Memorable Team Experiences: Work hard, play hard — even from a distance. Our online team-building events and all-hands gatherings bring humor, memes, and a lively atmosphere that makes teamwork genuinely fun. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/belkins-sales-development-representative-intake-pod

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no…
items.description: Who we are At Twilio , we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . Hiring and how we work We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. . See yourself at Twilio Join the team as Twilio’s next Director of Global Campaigns. About the job As the head of the Twilio Global Campaign team, you are responsible for owning, developing and executing the major campaigns that drive awareness and opportunities for Twilio. This role is highly cross functional, working closely with both internal marketing partners across regions, sales, product, and company leadership to design end-to-end campaigns that deliver on business objectives. You possess a proven track record of leading multi-channel global campaigns with success, collaborating with stakeholders, and finding opportunities to strategically uplevel Twilio’s campaign engine. The ideal candidate has an advanced understanding of how campaigns resonate with a global audience, not just one country. You are skilled in understanding the modern AI-driven buyer journey at each stage of the funnel, have the ability to translate messaging frameworks into effective campaigns, and thrives in a collaborative environment. You recognize the value of running an integrated campaign motion, and have the ability to think both strategically and execute at an operational level with ease. Your performance will be measured by your ability to execute and achieve measurable results including building brand awareness, developing a system of content and assets that is valuable to all regions, and building campaigns that accelerate growth velocity. Responsibilities In this role, you will: Set a strategic vision for global campaign structure, operations, and execution for our top 5 campaign motions. We are looking for someone who is very strategic in terms of knowing the audience, how to create content that resonates, tactics to reach that audience, and ideas that are visionary and tactical. Be accountable to company leadership on the effectiveness of all global campaigns and programs Strong project management skills and ability to use data to guide decision-making and resource allocation. Design and execute strategic end-to-end campaigns that both engage and convert prospective buyers with a focus on specific buyer and vertical segments Partner with product marketing, content strategists, brand strategists, creative designers and other regional campaign teams to create campaign themes and messaging that translate into impactful marketing campaigns. Act as the central point of contact to direct all campaign work across teams to ensure timely results Build strong relationships with key cross functional stakeholders across multiple organizations to ensure campaign enablement and engagement A global systems approach. Develop scalable, repeatable campaign playbooks that can be scaled quickly with a large variety of content that works in all regions Track program results , measure program success and report metrics to customer success, sales and marketing stakeholders and executives. Then analyze campaign performance, surface insights and provide recommendations for optimizing results AI-Driven Enablement: We want you to infuse AI frameworks into all aspects of the campaign model. Ideally you would disrupt the norms and evolve the team and programs to be progressive. And equip teams across the organization with the tools, guidelines, and frameworks to create high-quality content at scale, including standards, reusable templates, and AI-assisted workflows that improve consistency, speed, and quality. Budget Management: Manage and allocate budget for campaign production resources across all campaign and persona needs, including original content, video production, localization, and agencies to ensure efficient and high-quality execution and return on investment Global team leadership: Manage a team with a global remit that spans all regions from the US to Europe to Asia, while working with company and brand leadership to execute all top-of-funnel campaigns. Qualifications Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! Required: Management experience: ability to inspire a team of strategists and show a vision of what is possible and where our teams should focus efforts Deep understanding of marketing funnel tactics and metrics by stage, PLG model and funnel Understanding of enterprise buying cycles, sales processes and stakeholders, especially in B2B tech Self-starter who excels in a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative high-growth environment Ability to manage multiple work streams and has presence with the team and leadership Strategic thinker with strong attention to detail 8+ years working as a campagin strategist in B2B or tech Proven experience building and delivering on integrated programs and managing all tools, processes, and assets Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to drive alignment, set expectations and drive to success Works well with cross-functional teams and executives, to ensure consistent content is delivered across the company A champion for fostering a culture of trust through feedback, communication, and transparency Desired: Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organization. Familiarity with localization tactics to ensure our content is accessible and inclusive across multiple countries. Experience with primary research strategies and types of content creation Strategic ability to see opportunities across campaigns and programs where new types of content and programs will thrive. Experience building world-class brands through premium content Experience with a variety of AI, design, analytics, and video tools. Proficiency in digital marketing tools and platforms such as Tableau, Salesforce, AEM, Google Analytics, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Canva Location This role will be remote based in Ireland or the UK Travel We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. What We Offer Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Twilio thinks big. Do you? We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. . Stay alert to recruitment fraud We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps. . Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

items.description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity Grafana Labs is looking for a Commercial Account Executive, Acquisition based in the Netherlands who will be responsible for prospecting and closing new business across the Benelux region . You will identify, nurture and close opportunities with new customers, manage forecasts and track customer data. We're strong proponents of a consultative sales approach - learn about the customer's needs first before talking products. Your expertise will be critical in helping articulate the value of our products, work with the customer during the trial phase and hand off a strong relationship to our Growth team. Ideally, you come from a technical background and have sold technical products before. What You’ll Be Doing Meet and exceed individual quarterly and annual sales goals Outbound prospecting into net-new customers Manage all aspects of the sales process (prospecting, sales meetings, product demos, proofs of concept, proposals, and negotiations) Cultivate sales through outbound prospecting and inbound leads Be able to understand and convey the value of both Grafana Cloud and Grafana Enterprise Become an expert in managing your sales pipeline in Salesforce Manage quote creation, order processing, and day-to-day customer requests What Makes You a Great Fit: 2+ Years of experience in infrastructure technology sales Demonstrated history of consistent goal achievement in a highly competitive environment (top 10% performer) Energetic, upbeat, entrepreneurial, tenacious team player Adaptable and with demonstrable experience in high velocity technology companies You will need to be an excellent communicator in all channels (in person, online, in writing) and able to form strong working relationships both in person and virtually Fluent in English & Dutch (both spoken & written). Bonus Points For: Familiarity with open source technology is a significant advantage Experience using Salesforce Experience using Command of the Message and MEDD(P)ICC is ideal Compensation & Rewards In the Netherlands, the OTE compensation range for this role is EUR 144,250 - EUR 180,250. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. #LI-Remote For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

The Opportunity: As a Senior Product Designer at Grafana Labs, you will join a growing Product Design organization of more than 25 designers, researchers, engineers, and design leaders distributed across six continents. You will work within a 100% remote R&D organization, so strong, proactive remote communication, collaboration, facilitation, and relationship building skills will be essential to your success. As Senior Product Designer for Grafana Cloud’s Knowledge Graph , you’ll design experiences for the context layer of Grafana Cloud that powers our entity graph, entity catalog and RCA workbench. Knowledge Graph automatically discovers services, infrastructure, and databases from the telemetry teams already have, maps how they depend on each other, and runs anomaly detection. This gives engineers, SREs, and their agents an up to date picture of their systems. We want anyone to be able to understand a system and resolve an incident faster, without writing queries or maintaining alert rules, not just the one person who happens to know it best. Over time, you will develop deep expertise in your product area and associated customer and user personas, use cases, and workflows, which will enable you to design tailored, role-driven experiences. You will also have an opportunity to contribute to the evolution of the Product Design team at Grafana by coaching and mentoring other designers, collaborating on team internal initiatives, and helping evolve new ways of working, learning, and having fun together as the team scales. What You’ll Be Doing: Enabling customers to easily understand and explore how their systems connect to each other. Find clear, simple ways to show complex, constantly-changing information without overwhelming the user Translate research and data to experiences that are easy to digest and break down complexity Tailor the experience to different target audiences, covering multiple user perspectives Work cross-functionally with peers and leaders in engineering, product management, technical writing, and GTM functions, as well as other members of the Product Design team Prioritise for delivering impact while balancing business priorities, customer wishes and technical considerations Document user needs and pain points, design directions, UX trade-offs, and detailed designs for specific features and enhancements Execute research and contribute to quantitative and qualitative research initiatives with researchers, cross-functional collaborators, customers, and members of the Grafana user community What Makes You a Great Fit: 7+ years of relevant design experience working on B2B/enterprise software products, ideally designing tools and services for developers or other highly technical users A portfolio of effective designs for complex products delivered in a fast-paced environment Experience running qualitative research in complex fields, building empathy with users and humans, their needs and pain points even when you have very little in common with them Ability to make design decisions that appropriately balance business goals, product priorities, customer feedback, research insights, and technical considerations Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple locations and time-zones to iteratively ship and evolve products while keeping the end design vision in mind Attention to detail and willingness to learn about a complex, very technical product space Experience working in a fully-remote, fast-paced environment where you are expected to share openly, default to transparency, and embrace your autonomy Bonus Points For: Experience designing complex, data-dense interfaces with a focus on clarity Ability to rapidly gain an understanding of a technical domain and associated customer needs and user workflows in order to design effective experiences within that domain Domain knowledge or experience related to observability, cloud infrastructure, and/or database monitoring Experience helping design teams, especially at engineering led companies, level up their practice, collaboration with partner functions, and user and organizational impact When you apply, please: Provide an example of an experience where decision-making in a complex area is made easy through a well-curated UI. Add a sentence or two about what you believe makes it effective. Compensation & Rewards: In Canada, the Base compensation range for this role is CAD $145,000 - CAD $182,000. items.title: Media Buyer FB
items.summary: Our client is an international product-based IT company specializing in the iGaming industry.
items.description: Our client is an international product-based IT company specializing in the iGaming industry. Founded in 2014, the company has been successfully operating on the market for more than 11 years, bringing together a team of 390+ professionals. Starting as a leader in the CIS region, the company is now actively expanding on a global scale. We are currently looking for a Middle/Senior Media Buyer to join the media buying team and work with scalable traffic across different GEOs and tiers. 📋 Key responsibilities and your contribution: Launch, manage, and scale Facebook advertising campaigns across Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Tier 3 GEOs. Full ownership of traffic performance and financial results, including PnL responsibility. Analyze and optimize key performance metrics: ROI, CR, CTR, CPM, CPA, PnL. Scale profitable campaigns without artificial budget caps. Work closely with offers, creatives, agencies, and internal teams to improve campaign efficiency. Test and adapt strategies based on changes in GEOs, offers, platforms, and market conditions. Identify bottlenecks in funnels and processes, propose and implement optimization solutions. Maintain clear communication, task-setting, and feedback loops within the team. 📚 Your qualifications: 2+ years of experience in media buying / traffic arbitrage. Deep understanding of Facebook Ads ecosystem and traffic acquisition mechanics. Proven experience managing monthly budgets from $50,000. Strong analytical mindset and confidence working with performance metrics and profitability models. Hands-on experience with analytics and tracking tools such as Power BI, Google Sheets, Voluum, Binom, Keitaro (or similar). Experience working with offers, creatives, and external partners (agencies, vendors). High level of responsibility for results and readiness to work with CRM and PnL models. Strong communication skills and ability to give and receive constructive feedback. Critical thinking, initiative, flexibility, and adaptability in a fast-changing environment. Benefits: ⭐ Time Off & Recovery: 20 working days of fully paid annual leave, fully paid sick leave, and public holidays off according to company policy. ⭐ Health & Wellness: A flexible Benefits cafeteria that allows you to choose the perks that fit you best, with options including medical support, regular check-ups, mental health services, or gym access. ⭐ Education & Development: Internal and external training, industry events, language courses, and professional service subscriptions. ⭐ Workspace & Tech: All necessary corporate equipment provided, the flexibility to work fully remotely, and premium digital tools to enhance performance (e.g., AI tools, ChatGPT Plus). ⭐ Work Environment & Perks: Holiday bonuses, gifts for special occasions, paid business trips, and team events. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: 1224SA - 377TEL | Project Accounting Specialist
items.summary: Telaid has been delivering technology deployment solutions to multi-site companies for over 37 years.
items.description: Telaid has been delivering technology deployment solutions to multi-site companies for over 37 years. We are a growing, privately held company looking for a dedicated Project Accounting Specialist to join our team. If you’re a detail-oriented finance professional who thrives in collaborative environments, loves improving processes, and is passionate about achieving financial goals, this opportunity is for you! Position Overview: As a Project Accounting Specialist , you will play a critical role in managing project finances, ensuring accuracy in billing and reporting, and supporting internal teams and external clients. This role is integral to Telaid’s commitment to reducing the time, task, risk, and cost of technology deployments. Key Responsibilities: Collaborate with Project Managers to gather timely and accurate information for monthly billings. Input project budgets and billing information into financial systems proactively. Generate invoices using various software and resolve billing-related issues with customers. Apply payments to customer accounts and reconcile discrepancies. Review credit reports for new customers to establish credit limits. Prepare periodic reports using accounting software. Participate in regular project review meetings to analyze financial performance and trends. Research and respond to inquiries from the Project Management Team regarding project costs and revenues. Develop project financial templates and support client onboarding to ensure smooth submission processes. Perform client submission verifications and address issues related to aging balances, escalating when necessary. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve billing and account-related discrepancies. Qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent (Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred). Minimum of 2 years of experience in billing and collections. Strong communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Detail-oriented with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, multitasking environment. Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel. Experience with Crystal Reports and Microsoft Power BI is a plus. Familiarity with ERP systems and project accounting environments is desirable. Why Join Telaid? Be part of a company that values collaboration, innovation, and process improvement. Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely while contributing to impactful technology deployment projects. Work with a supportive team and develop your skills in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment. If you’re ready to make a difference and grow your career with Telaid, we’d love to hear from you! Apply today to join our mission of delivering excellence in technology deployments. Originally posted on Himalayas

Support ongoing training and education of staff to promote HMDA awareness and compliance best practices. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Proficiency in Encompass and strong understanding of its functionality as it relates to HMDA data. Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills including: Adding columns and reformatting spreadsheets Filtering data Performing basic formulas (subtraction, IF statements, VLOOKUP) Strong understanding of the mortgage origination process , from application through processing, underwriting, and closing Familiarity with loan documentation and the data fields critical to HMDA reporting. items.title: Travel Expert | Reviewer
items.summary: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants.
items.description: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants. Your job isn’t to “write itineraries.” It’s to think like a real trip planner and spot what makes a travel situation real, feasible, and decision-changing — then upgrade weak scenarios so they actually test the model. ‼️ AI is not allowed. If we spot AI use, we’ll block the application. ⚠️ This application form must be completed entirely in English. 🚨 READ ALL THE DESCRIPTION BELOW TO UNDERSTAND THE APPLICATION FORM. WHO CAN APPLY Travel professionals and experienced trip planners 3+ years of relevant travel planning experience (professional or high-volume personal) English level: Advanced / Fluent (required) WHAT YOU’LL DO IN THE APPLICATION (QUICK SCREENING TEST) You will review two pre-generated travel tasks . For each task, you’ll answer simple 1–5 ratings and give a short justification. Then, for the 2nd task , you’ll rewrite it to make it stronger . WHAT “STRONG” MEANS (SIMPLE DEFINITION) A strong task includes one decisive feasibility constraint that can flip the plan if ignored (missed train, missed check-in, closed attraction, wrong station, etc.). We call this a Knife : A Knife is a constraint that changes what itinerary is actually viable . Quick test: if you remove it, the “best plan” would meaningfully change. Examples of Knives in Travel Last train / last entry / check-in cutoff times Closures and holidays that change what’s possible Ambiguous locations (airport/station names that can be confused) Sequential dependencies (if A slips, B becomes impossible) Mobility constraints that change routing feasibility WHAT YOU WILL RATE (1–5) IN THE FORM You’ll give 3 ratings per task: Overall Quality (1–5) How clear and testable the task is (can you judge PASS/FAIL)? Knife / Hidden Context Strength (1–5) Is there a decisive feasibility constraint — or is the “hidden context” just extra color that doesn’t change the plan? Checklist Quality (1–5) Does the checklist truly test feasibility + the Knife with clear criteria? (Strong checklists include verification steps and forbid inventing logistics, written as PASS/FAIL — not “be helpful.”) You’ll also write a short justification (2–4 bullets) explaining your ratings. WHAT YOU WILL REWRITE (FOR THE 2ND TASK ONLY) You will rewrite these parts to make the task stronger: Scenario (3rd person) — more realistic + naturally sets up the feasibility risk Prompt (user message) — natural, human, does not reveal the Knife Hidden Context (1–3 bullets) — must include exactly 1 decisive Knife Checklist (4–6 items) — each item must be PASS/FAIL, covering: feasibility/verification (minimum unknowns to check) the Knife (the decision-flipping constraint) no invented logistics (no made-up schedules/hours/availability) branching plan (Plan A / Plan B) when feasibility depends on one missing answer safety only when there is real risk Checklist item example: PASS if it flags what must be verified (tickets/hours/cutoffs) before committing; FAIL if it confidently invents times or availability. Important: Don’t “leak” the Knife in the prompt (no “IMPORTANT”, no all-caps, no “the key detail is…”). IF SELECTED (PROJECT WORK) You’ll review batches of pre-generated travel scenarios: Rating realism and feasibility risk Identifying weak or missing constraints (Knives) Improving tasks so they better represent real travel moments where wrong advice causes missed connections, wasted money, or ruined plans COMPENSATION Payment will be US$ 30 per approved task, converted and paid in your local currency. Each task takes approximately 40 minutes, which corresponds to an effective rate of about US$ 45 per hour. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR You can recognize what’s realistic vs. generic in travel planning You understand what truly flips feasibility (cutoffs, closures, dependencies, ambiguous locations) You can upgrade a “fine” scenario into a strong feasibility test without making it artificial Originally posted on Himalayas

With a strong international presence and a network of distributors, subsidiaries, and partners across multiple markets, our client serves customers worldwide through a variety of sales and distribution channels. About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. You will conduct online research, analyze seller and product data, maintain accurate records, and prepare reports that provide actionable insights to the business. Maintain accurate seller databases and internal records. Prepare daily reports and monthly Voice of Consumer reports. Build and maintain dashboards tracking brand-protection metrics. Identify opportunities to improve research and reporting processes. items.description: Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential. We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy. Position Overview The Manager, Customer Success (CS Manager) is a pivotal leadership role within the Customer Success organization. Your full professional capacity is invested in one outcome: building, developing, and leading a high-performing CS team that consistently delivers exceptional retention, expansion, and customer outcomes across the portfolio. The CS Manager is not a removed administrator. You are a hands-on people leader who is deeply connected to the day-to-day work of your team — present in account reviews, coaching conversations, renewal pipelines, and at-risk escalations. You understand the team’s accounts well enough to guide strategy, spot risk early, and develop each CSM's capabilities in the context of real work; but do so as a leader and coach, not as an account owner. The ideal candidate brings mastery of CS execution and is now ready to direct that expertise entirely toward the growth and performance of others. You are energized by developing people, committed to building scalable team systems, and commercially literate enough to hold the team accountable to the metrics that matter. items.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
items.summary: The Opportunity: Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. items.description: The Opportunity: Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. As a Senior Demand Generation Manager, you'll own both halves of the pipeline engine: the campaigns that create demand, and the systems that capture, route, score, and measure it. You'll lead paid media across channels like Google, LinkedIn, and YouTube and drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables. You'll shape HubSpot as an architect, not just a user, and build the reporting that tells our leadership team whether any of it worked. This isn't a blank slate: paid channels are already live with an agency in place, the event calendar is established, and HubSpot and attribution already exist. You're inheriting a functioning engine, with plenty of authority to make it even stronger. It's a small team with a large surface area, so roughly two thirds of your time goes toward driving demand through campaign strategy, paid media, and events, and the other third goes toward building the systems that make that demand measurable and repeatable through HubSpot architecture, lifecycle programs, and attribution. In this role, one person connects both sides of the engine, creating a much tighter link between what we invest, what we learn, and what ultimately produces pipeline. You'll have real authority to change what isn't working from day one, and on a team this size, a fix you make on Tuesday can be live by Friday. By the end of the year, you'll be the person leadership trusts for a straight answer on whether campaigns and events are actually working. What You'll Do Translate GTM priorities, ICP definitions, and quarterly pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid, events, and email, then build and ship them yourself. Own paid media end to end, building, launching, and optimizing campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and YouTube while partnering with our agency on execution. Drive the event calendar, including trade shows, webinars, and executive roundtables, sharpening targeting and follow-through while focusing investment on what delivers results. Carry a quarterly qualified-pipeline number and defend coverage, quality, and conversion with sales leadership, not just volume. Architect HubSpot as an owner, managing workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, campaign objects, and the Salesforce sync. Build and defend the metrics that matter, including CPL, cost per qualified opportunity, event-sourced pipeline, and multi-touch attribution. Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, and RevOps internally, and agencies, venues, and sponsors externally, to run multiple concurrent campaigns and events without dropping a thread. What You'll Bring A track record of hands-on HubSpot ownership, having personally architected and administered an instance, including workflows, lifecycle, scoring, campaigns, and the Salesforce sync. Direct paid media execution, with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and pacing campaigns in Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager, not just briefing an agency. Salesforce fluency, with the ability to navigate objects, fields, and reports and reason about how marketing data lands in the CRM and why it breaks. B2B SaaS demand generation experience, ideally within a considered, multi-stakeholder sales cycle. Experience owning event strategy and execution, including trade shows, webinars, and executive-level programs like roundtables or dinners. Comfort owning a function end to end, balancing strategy with hands-on execution in an individual contributor role. Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to effectively manage internal stakeholders and external vendors and partners. Bonus Points Experience in privacy, data governance, security, compliance, or another regulated, technical software category. Marketo or Pardot experience alongside HubSpot. Familiarity with account-based marketing or intent-data tools. Comfort using AI to speed up operational work, such as campaign QA, data hygiene, or reporting synthesis. Experience being the first or founding owner of a demand gen or marketing ops function, from the ground up with hands-on responsibility for building and scaling it. What Success Looks Like Within 90 Days You'll: Learn DataGrail's product, buyer personas, and ICP quickly enough to start contributing, not just observing, and meet the marketing, sales, RevOps, and customer success teams to understand what's running and where the friction is. Take full ownership of the paid channels and the agency relationship, and identify specific over- or under-spending by channel. Drive the event calendar and process, and produce a keep, fix, or cut recommendation for each program. Audit HubSpot and existing reporting, and deliver a written list of what's fragile, missing, or misleading in current attribution and lifecycle reporting. Ship at least one visible fix to a live, underperforming channel or process Within 180 Days You'll: Show measurable improvement, with before and after comparisons, on two to three of the biggest inefficiencies identified in the 90-day audit, whether that's rebalanced paid spend, improved event-to-pipeline conversion, or cleaner attribution. Run paid media and events with full autonomy, proposing and executing budget and calendar changes without waiting on sign-off. Ship at least three new or rebuilt nurture and re-engagement tracks, with early performance data on each. Rebuild or upgrade the dashboards used for weekly pipeline calls. Build a working rhythm with Sales, RevOps, and Product Marketing so hand-offs, routing, and lead flow don't require chasing people down. Within 365 Days You'll: Own a program for paid media, events, and HubSpot that runs noticeably better than the one you inherited, with clear before and after numbers on channel efficiency and cost per qualified opportunity. Be the person others trust when they want to know how well our campaigns and events are actually performing. Have made real budget and channel calls, moving spend into what works and cutting what doesn't, with pipeline impact you can point to. Have built a foundation that doesn't need rebuilding when volume doubles. Have identified where the team needs more support, whether that's tooling, headcount, or an agency change, and made the case for it. Please note that the base compensation range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US-based job postings regardless of state. All full-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental & vision insurance plans, remote-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change. Compensation Range $140,000—$165,000 USD About Us: DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human-governed AI that scales. Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500+ integrations and no-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two-time recognized privacy leader by IDC. DataGrail provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

items.description: US Marketing Lead Location: United States Reports to: VP of Marketing Employment type: Full-time About Teton Teton is building the autonomous operating system for care. Our technology gives senior living and care teams greater visibility into resident wellbeing, movement, sleep, and care delivery, helping them respond faster, work more efficiently, and provide more personalized care. We are growing quickly across the United States and are looking for a US Marketing Lead to own our regional marketing strategy and execution. The Role The US Marketing Lead will be the territory owner for Teton’s growth and brand presence in the United States. You will translate Teton’s global positioning and company priorities into a focused US marketing plan that creates demand, strengthens our reputation, and helps the sales team win. This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the regional strategy, build campaigns, produce sales materials, support events, coordinate PR, and measure what is working. You will work closely with US Sales, Customer Success, Product Marketing, Events, Growth, and external partners. You will report to the VP of Marketing and serve as the primary marketing partner for the US commercial team. What You’ll Own US Marketing Strategy Develop and execute the US marketing plan in alignment with company revenue goals and global marketing priorities. Identify the audiences, markets, partnerships, and channels most likely to drive growth. Adapt Teton’s global campaigns and positioning for the US senior living and care market. Maintain a clear regional campaign calendar, budget, and set of priorities. Bring insights from customers, prospects, competitors, and the market back into the broader marketing organization. Demand Generation and Campaigns Partner with Growth Lead to build and run integrated campaigns across email, paid media, content, webinars, events, partnerships, and other relevant channels. Create campaigns around Teton’s most important customer problems and product capabilities. Own regional email strategy, segmentation, nurture programs, and campaign follow-up. Work with Growth to improve lead generation, conversion, and account engagement. Develop targeted programs for priority accounts, operator groups, and strategic market segments. Ensure leads are properly captured, routed, followed up on, and measured in HubSpot. Sales Enablement Serve as the primary marketing partner to the US sales organization. Develop and maintain US-specific sales decks, case studies, one-pagers, proposals, follow-up materials, and campaign assets. Translate product capabilities into clear operational and commercial value for senior living operators. Equip sales with the proof points, customer stories, and market insights needed to move opportunities forward. Support account-based campaigns for strategic prospects and active opportunities. Gather regular feedback from Sales and Customer Success to identify gaps in messaging, content, and enablement. Events, Webinars, and Partnerships Partner with the Events lead to determine which US conferences, webinars, executive gatherings, and field programs deserve investment. Build pre-event, on-site, and post-event campaigns that generate meetings and measurable pipeline. Support speaker submissions, presentations, sponsorships, customer participation, and event messaging. Develop regional partnerships with associations, media organizations, technology partners, and other industry stakeholders. Ensure events are connected to broader campaigns rather than treated as standalone activities. Content, Customer Stories, and PR Identify strong US customer stories and work with Customer Success to turn them into case studies, testimonials, videos, and campaign assets. Develop content that reflects the priorities and language of US senior living operators. Work with internal subject-matter experts to produce thought leadership, educational content, reports, and webinars. Coordinate with Teton’s PR partners on announcements, contributed articles, awards, speaking opportunities, and media relationships. Help establish Teton and its leadership as credible voices in the US senior living market. Product Positioning and Market Intelligence Localize global product positioning for US audiences while maintaining consistency with Teton’s overall narrative. Develop messaging for different US customer segments, buyer roles, and stages of the sales process. Monitor competitors, category trends, customer needs, and changes in the senior living market. Partner with Product Marketing and Product to support launches and communicate new capabilities effectively. Ensure US market feedback is reflected in future campaigns, content, and product messaging. Measurement and Reporting Define regional goals and report on campaign performance, lead generation, pipeline contribution, event results, and channel effectiveness. Maintain clear dashboards and regular updates for Marketing and US commercial leadership. Use performance data to improve targeting, messaging, campaign investment, and sales follow-up. Establish a consistent process for evaluating what is working, what is not, and where the team should focus next. What Success Looks Like In your first year, you will have: Established a clear and credible US marketing strategy tied to Teton’s commercial goals. Built a consistent campaign engine that generates qualified demand and supports pipeline growth. Improved the quality and consistency of US sales enablement. Created a repeatable approach to US events, webinars, partnerships, and account-based programs. Expanded Teton’s library of US customer proof points and case studies. Increased Teton’s visibility and credibility with senior living operators and industry stakeholders. Created transparent reporting that shows how US marketing contributes to revenue. What We’re Looking For 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in healthcare technology, senior living, or enterprise software industry. Experience owning a regional, vertical, or business-unit marketing strategy. A track record of building integrated campaigns that contribute to pipeline and revenue. Strong sales enablement experience and the ability to work closely with enterprise sales teams. Experience with events, content, email marketing, webinars, account-based marketing, and demand generation. Excellent writing, editing, messaging, and presentation skills. Strong project-management skills and the ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution. Comfort working in a fast-growing company where priorities can change and processes are still being built. Strong analytical judgment and experience using marketing and CRM data to make decisions. Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and related marketing tools is preferred. Knowledge of the US senior living or healthcare market is highly valuable. The Person We Think Will Thrive You are a strong generalist who knows how to turn company goals into focused regional execution. You can write a campaign brief, improve a sales deck, develop an event plan, interview a customer, analyze lead performance, and present a clear recommendation to leadership. You are commercially minded, comfortable working directly with sales, and focused on producing work that helps the company grow. You bring structure without creating unnecessary process, and you know how to balance brand building with near-term pipeline needs. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

items.summary: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s. 3. Product Rollout Support Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company. Originally posted on Himalayas

The ideal candidate is analytical, data-driven, and comfortable balancing campaign execution with performance strategy. Manage advertising budgets and scale high-performing campaigns. Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to improve campaign results. Proven experience optimizing campaigns based on ROAS, CPA, CAC, and profitability. Strong understanding of conversion funnels and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards. Experience managing six-figure monthly advertising budgets is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with eCommerce, SaaS, Lead Generation, or Performance Marketing campaigns. Ability to translate data into actionable optimization strategies.
