items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote - United States About Vercel: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. About the Role: We are looking for a Product Manager to own the Vercel Dashboard, the control plane for every Vercel user, defining how developers and teams interact with Vercel from first login through daily use, across both individual accounts and enterprise organizations. You will lead the shift from what is a project listing page today to a personalized, agent-powered surface that proactively helps users ship and discover value. You will report to the Product Lead and will be located in San Francisco, CA (hybrid). If you're based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team. What You Will Do: Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Vercel Dashboard, the primary surface through which all Vercel customers interact with the platform Define how agents operate within the Dashboard, from surfacing errors and suggesting fixes to updating code and config on behalf of users Shift the Dashboard from a passive "pull" experience to a proactive "push" experience, surfacing insights, notifications, and recommended actions Define the information architecture and design patterns that product area teams build within, and partner with those teams (Billing, CI/CD, Observability) to keep their experiences consistent and high-quality within the Dashboard shell Collaborate with Engineering to hold an uncompromising performance bar. The Dashboard must be the fastest, most delightful surface at Vercel Run experiments and measure onboarding funnel performance, feature adoption, and engagement across user segments About You: You've built and shipped developer-facing products You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, cloud, or developer tools companies You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple You think about the product from both a human and an agent perspective. You use AI tools in your own workflow and have a point of view on how agents should interact with product surfaces You have experience running experiments and working with product analytics to drive roadmap decisions Bonus If You: Have worked on platform or horizontal product teams where you set patterns that other teams adopt Have an engineering background or have built software yourself Have worked on onboarding, activation, or growth loops in a product-led growth context Have experience with personalization frameworks or systems that adapt to user segments and lifecycle stages Benefits: Competitive compensation package, including equity. Inclusive Healthcare Package. Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. Flexible Time Off. items.description: Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time. At Nextiva , we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation. Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are. If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong. Location: While this role is open to remote candidates across Mexico, team members located within 80 kilometers of our Guadalajara office (Calle Amado Nervo 2200, Jardínes del Sol, 45050 Zapopan, Jal.) are expected to work onsite to support collaboration, speed, and execution. Nextiva is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own and modernize our CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling. You’ll focus on one of the most important parts of the engineering experience: getting code from commit to production quickly, reliably, and safely. You’ll work closely with engineering teams to improve pipelines, reduce developer friction, strengthen deployment practices, and create reusable tooling that makes the right way to ship software the easy way. Nextiva’s platform is built on a modern microservices architecture, and reliability and adaptability are central to how we serve customers. Our broader platform strategy also leverages AI and automation to create better outcomes, making this role important to how our engineering organization continues to scale and evolve. What you’ll do Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines as code across multiple services and engineering teams. Improve deployment safety through progressive delivery strategies including canary, blue/green, and feature-flag-based releases. Build reusable pipeline templates, shared libraries, and self-service tooling that make it easier for teams to onboard and ship consistently. Improve build performance through caching, parallelization, and other approaches that reduce pipeline execution and feedback time. Partner with engineering teams to identify and remove friction from local development, testing, CI, and deployment workflows. Integrate appropriate AI-assisted capabilities into developer workflows, including use cases such as pipeline diagnostics, test generation or selection, code-review automation, and failure triage. Implement software supply-chain practices including dependency scanning, artifact signing, and SBOM generation. Use Infrastructure-as-Code to provision and maintain the infrastructure supporting CI/CD. Monitor pipeline health and deployment success and use those signals to drive continuous improvements. Help engineering teams adopt effective DevOps and delivery practices through clear communication, enablement, and reusable solutions. What you bring Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 5+ years of DevOps or software engineering experience, with a strong focus on CI/CD and developer tooling. Strong hands-on experience with modern CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, or Buildkite. Experience designing pipelines as code and reusable pipeline templates. Solid understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and deploying containerized applications through CI/CD. Working knowledge of Infrastructure-as-Code, including Terraform and/or Ansible. Strong Linux administration and scripting skills using Bash, Python, or Go. Experience with middleware or messaging technologies such as Kafka, Redis, or RabbitMQ. Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or ELK. Strong communication skills and experience driving adoption of tooling across engineering teams. Progressive delivery tooling such as Argo Rollouts, Flagger, or feature-flag platforms. Additional experience that will help you succeed Software supply-chain security tooling such as Nexus, Sigstore/cosign, Syft/SBOM tooling, Snyk, or Trivy. Experience applying AI/LLM-based tools to engineering workflows. AI literacy We’re looking for someone who understands where AI can genuinely improve engineering workflows rather than applying it for its own sake. Experience using AI/LLM-assisted tooling to accelerate development, testing, troubleshooting, code review, or CI/CD workflows. Ability to evaluate AI-generated recommendations or outputs critically before incorporating them into production engineering processes. Curiosity about opportunities such as intelligent test selection, flaky-test detection, automated checks, and pipeline failure diagnostics. Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies) Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors: Drives Results : Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go. Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work. Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates. Total Rewards Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office. Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary, hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses. Health - Major Health insurance for you, your legal partner, and children under 25 years, including Vision and Dental coverage Insurance - Life Insurance (24 times your monthly salary) Work-Life Balance ⚖️ - Newly hired full-time employees at Nextiva receive 10 personal days before their first anniversary, 12 vacation days on their first anniversary, and 5 personal days annually thereafter in addition to vacation time Financial Security - Enjoy a 30-day Christmas bonus, 50% vacation premium, company-matched food vouchers (1 UMA/month), and a 13% matched savings fund (capped at 1.3x annual UMA) Wellness ‍ - Employee Assistance Program and comprehensive wellness initiatives Growth - Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career! #LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE Founded in 2008, Nextiva has grown into a global leader trusted by over 100,000 businesses and 1M+ users worldwide. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with teams across the globe, we're the future of customer experience and team collaboration through our AI-powered, conversation-centric platform. Want to see what life at Nextiva is all about? Connect with us on Instagram , Instagram MX , YouTube , LinkedIn , and the Nextiva Blog .

items.description: All Other Remote Headquarters: United States - Remote We're transforming the grocery industry At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. Instacart is a Flex First team There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. Why this role is on the menu We're hiring an Account Manager II to make Instacart Ads the place CPG advertisers and agencies trust to grow their business, by improving campaign performance, widening how brands invest across our ad products, and shaping the advertiser experience. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy and campaign performance, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to advertiser growth and retention. Twelve months from now, the advertisers you partner with should see Instacart as a growth partner whose recommendations they act on. What you'll cook up in your first year Advertiser Relationships: CPG clients and agency partners treat you as a trusted advisor. Working with Sales, you understand their business objectives and build strategies that support their long-term growth on Instacart. Campaign Performance: Each advertiser has a full-funnel media strategy tied to its goals. You use campaign data and marketplace insights to recommend investment and optimization approaches that measurably improve results, and you manage gap-to-goal across multiple business units. Advertiser Growth: Advertisers adopt your optimization and upsell recommendations and expand their use of Instacart advertising products. You get there by explaining clearly how each product works, building persuasive narratives, and handling objections with confidence across multiple stakeholders. Business Reviews: Recurring client conversations and quarterly business reviews turn campaign data into a clear story of business impact, opportunities, and next steps. You own the vision and content for these reviews, and advertisers leave knowing what to do next. You also resolve campaign and partner issues with limited guidance. Product and Team Influence: Advertiser pain points reach the right internal teams as specific feedback that shapes product enhancements and process improvements. You also share best practices across the category and Advertiser Success teams and lead projects that strengthen team-wide capabilities. The secret ingredients we're looking for You are customer-focused and analytical, comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, and energized by a fast-paced role where priorities and solutions keep evolving. You use judgment and initiative to balance immediate client needs against longer-term chances to improve products, processes, and advertiser outcomes, and you are at your best explaining complex campaign data in plain terms. Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications) Bachelor's degree in business, advertising, commerce, digital marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 4+ years of experience in account management, digital advertising, paid media, ad operations, ecommerce, client services, or a related field Experience building and maintaining strong client relationships in an external-facing role Experience analyzing campaign or business performance data and turning findings into clear recommendations and client-facing narratives Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, and Slides) Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced, changing environment Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting confidently to advertisers, agencies, and internal stakeholders Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications) Experience with Salesforce and Tableau; familiarity with Mode is a plus Knowledge of paid search, display advertising, ad serving, consumer packaged goods, or ecommerce, and experience developing full-funnel media strategies and optimizing campaigns against performance goals Experience managing business reviews, quota-related planning, upsell opportunities, or growth strategies across multiple business units Strong attention to detail and organization, creative problem solving, and experience influencing product or operational improvements by synthesizing customer feedback and business insights #LI-Remote Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. This role also includes a Sales Incentive Plan. The cash variable incentive target is based on individual sales performance. Payout terms will be based on the Sales incentive Plan for this role. items.title: Fraud Analyst
items.summary: Who are we? TripledotStudios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.
items.description: Who are we? Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. The role is working within our studio: PuzzlePlay Puzzleplay is Tripledot’s new player rewards platform, designed to make playing our games even more fun and engaging. By playing our casual, free to play mobile games, users can earn points, complete challenges, and win real prizes. It’s our way of giving back to players and rewarding them for doing what they already love. Puzzleplay is a key part of our growth strategy, combining smart engagement mechanics with high-quality game content. Role Overview Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. The team is building a system that combines fraud and activity signals to understand users and inform revenue-share decisions. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change. Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market. This role is open to candidates based in Europe; Warsaw is preferred, where several of the people you'll work with are based. Key Responsibilities Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns. Own the fraud-related segments of the user segmentation system, from deciding how signals should be interpreted to monitoring how well the categories work over time. Work with the product team on fraud verification tools for different markets. The team currently uses FaceTec for facial verification and may need other methods, such as ID scanning or phone verification, in other countries. Investigate users flagged for manual review, including ambiguous cases in the Tremendous queue, and look for ways to improve the review process. Identify gaps in the available signals and recommend third-party tools for the product roadmap where they would help. Required Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Hands-on experience using data to investigate fraud and shape detection or prevention decisions, not just working alongside a fraud team. Experience designing or improving fraud signals, user segments or review processes, with an interest in how those decisions change as tactics evolve. The ability to work with product and other teams to turn analysis into operational fraud controls. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Vice President, Public Relations (Health)
items.summary: WHO WE ARE The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years.
items.description: WHO WE ARE The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month. Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for, and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result. Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment. We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us. THE ROLE We are seeking an accomplished and strategic leader to join the team as a Vice President, Health. This role requires a seasoned professional with deep expertise in the healthcare industries, outstanding communication skills, and a proven track record in client management and team leadership. As the Vice President, you will spearhead PR initiatives for our clients, lead thought leadership, drive business growth, and deliver impactful results that enhance their reputation and visibility in the market. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Leadership: Provide visionary leadership and strategic direction for the health and lifestyle industries, guiding team members to achieve excellence and drive results. Client Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with healthcare clients, serving as the primary point of contact and ensuring delivery of high-quality PR services. Strategy Development: Develop comprehensive PR strategies tailored to each client's objectives and target audience, leveraging industry knowledge and market insights. Campaign Execution: Oversee the implementation of PR campaigns, including media relations, thought leadership initiatives, crisis communications, and executive visibility programs. Team Management: Lead, mentor, and empower a team of PR professionals specializing in health and lifestyle services, fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment. Media Relations: Build and maintain relationships with key health and lifestyle contacts, securing impactful placements in top-tier outlets and healthcare publications. Thought Leadership: Position clients as industry thought leaders through strategic content development, speaking opportunities, and participation in relevant industry events and conferences. Crisis Communications: Develop and implement crisis communication plans to safeguard clients' reputation and mitigate reputational risks in the event of crises or negative publicity. Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for optimization and continuous improvement. WHAT YOU'LL OWN IN YEAR ONE Own the practice's account management rhythm with structured weekly business reviews, account health scoring, and proactive risk identification across the existing client book Bring practice-level retention into the top quartile of the firm through tight service delivery, fast time-to-value on new accounts, and structured save-the-account interventions where necessary Develop and execute 5+ recurring expansion plays within the existing client base, building toward 1.5–2% monthly MRR expansion as a sustained rate Lead and develop the existing healthcare team, direct senior coaching, selective recruiting, and accountability for delivery quality Build a productized healthcare service offering that leverages the Interviewed platform: competitive intelligence, regulatory media monitoring, KOL targeting, payer narrative tracking Win new healthcare clients in partnership with our new business team, with focus on biotech, pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, digital health, and consumer wellness Represent the practice externally, industry events, healthcare-specific publications, thought leadership in the healthcare communications space QUALIFICATIONS Minimum of 15 years of experience in public relations, with a focus on the healthcare and lifestyle industries. Proven track record of successfully managing PR campaigns for healthcare clients, with measurable results in media placements and client satisfaction. Strong leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team to achieve excellence. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to craft compelling narratives and communicate complex healthcare and lifestyle concepts effectively. Strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the healthcare industry. Extensive network of media contacts and industry connections within the healthcare and lifestyle sectors Results-oriented with a passion for delivering high-quality work and exceeding client expectations. WHO YOU ARE 15+ years in healthcare communications or healthcare PR, with senior leadership experience leading teams and owning practice-level outcomes Demonstrated specialty depth in at least three of: FDA and regulatory communications, biotech and pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, payer relations, clinical trial communications, digital health, healthcare policy A documented track record of measurable client retention and expansion you can describe in numbers Comfortable carrying gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, and expansion as primary KPIs, not just media impressions and placements Strong network of healthcare media contacts across business, trade, clinical, and consumer publications Strategic operator, equally fluent in client strategy, team development, and operational rigor Comfortable with AI-driven workflows and a data-disciplined approach to earned media WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE 🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the world while you enjoy the flexibility of your fully remote workplace. Skip the annoying commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth. 🩺 Comprehensive Health Benefits - Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being. 💰 Retirement Savings - Save for the future with our 401(k) program, including a company match that is increasing further to 3% in 2027 . 🌴 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, 11 company holidays, a floating holiday, and Summer Fridays to recharge and spend more time doing what you love. 👶 Paid Parental Leave - We support growing families with paid parental leave, giving new parents dedicated time to recover, bond with their baby, and return to work with confidence. 📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing strategic integrated marketing and communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people like you grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with meaningful real impact. 🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed. HOW TO APPLY Submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and one additional document we genuinely want to read: a one-page write-up of your most significant healthcare client retention or expansion outcome. Tell us what the situation was, what you did, and the numbers you moved. The write-up will be weighted more heavily than the resume. Originally posted on Himalayas

We grow through two distinct routes to market – government programmes, and commercial data and subscription products – and our product and engineering teams build the platform that powers both. Hydrosat is hiring a Director of International BD & Sales to bost growth, identify and develop strategic opportunities, and strengthen our position across international government markets. You will own Hydrosat ’s international partner ecosystem, shape market-entry strategies, and identify relevant government programs before they reach formal procurement. Working closely with the VP Global, Government Programs, you will represent Hydrosat with senior customers and partners, make recommendations on where the company should invest its resources, and coordinate early-stage opportunities into qualified captures. Identify and engage relevant local partners, institutional stakeholders, and decision-makers. Produce actionable country and market strategies for leadership decision-making. Represent Hydrosat in selected customer, partner, and institutional engagements. Track national and international procurement platforms. Qualify opportunities based on strategic fit, funding, customer access, competitive position, timing, and probability of success. Develop preliminary capture strategies and make clear go/no-go recommendations. Position Hydrosat with key stakeholders before formal procurements are released. Advance qualified opportunities into structured captures Contribute to the development and adoption of Hydrosat ’s value proposition across government markets. Maintain accurate partner, market, and opportunity intelligence in CRM. Requirements At least eight years of experience in international business development, partnerships, channel management, market strategy, or capture. Demonstrated success building commercial partnerships and developing complex government or institutional opportunities. Strong commercial judgment and the ability to operate independently across multiple markets. Confidence engaging senior government, institutional, and industry stakeholders. A proactive, resourceful personality with strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail. Ability to turn fragmented market information into clear strategies, priorities, and actions. Excellent written and spoken English. French, Spanish, Portugeuse, or another European language is a strong plus. Experience in Earth observation, space, geospatial intelligence, government markets, water management, agriculture, climate technology, or deep tech is preferred. items.title: Freelancing Engagement: Technical Marketing & MRD Specialist (m/f/d)
items.summary: the opportunity We are looking for a Technical Marketing & MRD Specialist on Smart Sensors & Edge AI to investigate, structure and document the market requirements for next-generation smart sensor applications powered by our Analog Edge AI low-power ASIC.
items.description: the opportunity We are looking for a Technical Marketing & MRD Specialist on Smart Sensors & Edge AI to investigate, structure and document the market requirements for next-generation smart sensor applications powered by our Analog Edge AI low-power ASIC. You bring a solid engineering background that enables you to understand our technology at a deep technical level and translate what you learn into precise, measurable requirements. You combine strong analytical and writing skills with a genuine understanding of technology markets. In this role, you translate market needs, customer problems and application requirements into a structured MRD that guides GEMESYS’s strategy, product, technology and business development activities. You work closely with our management, engineers and business developers to answer critical questions such as: Which smart sensor markets have the strongest need for local or edge AI, meaning on-device learning, inference, event or anomaly detection, or data compression? What problems are customers currently unable to solve efficiently? What sensor capabilities, AI functions and performance levels are required? Which applications benefit most from on-device learning and inference? What are the requirements around power consumption, latency and bandwidth? Which technical requirements are driven by customers, and which by competitors or industry standards? Which product requirements should GEMESYS prioritize for its Edge AI technology? The goal is an MRD that engineering can design against: every requirement quantified, prioritized per segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases. your role Market & Application Research Build a deep understanding of our analog AI hardware, its capabilities and limitations, together with our team. Research the global smart sensor and Edge AI landscape and identify relevant market segments, applications and customer groups. Analyze emerging applications for intelligent and autonomous sensors. Investigate industry trends, technology adoption and customer requirements. Identify high-value use cases where local or edge AI processing provides tangible benefits. Identify opportunities where GEMESYS’s Analog Edge AI architecture creates differentiated value, also beyond sensors. Research competing technologies and alternative solutions, with the support of our engineers. Customer & Stakeholder Requirements Identify and structure customer pain points and unmet needs. Translate qualitative customer requirements into measurable product requirements. Define functional and non-functional requirements for smart sensor systems. Classify these requirements into categories, so that the engineering teams can make trade-offs. Source and conduct customer, expert and partner interviews through your own network, and run the market validation independently. Share your findings with management, and join selected customer and investor meetings where they add value. Market Requirements Document You own the development of a comprehensive MRD, including: Market overview, segmentation and competitive landscape Target applications and use cases Customer personas and stakeholders, where relevant Customer pain points and unmet needs Market and technology trends and their future projections Alternative technology approaches Market and product specification requirements for our Analog Edge AI ASIC: power, energy modes, bandwidth, area, process nodes, target ASP and further parameters, prioritized per segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases Product opportunity areas Recommendations for product and technology development Regulatory and industry considerations Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with GEMESYS’s technical teams to understand the capabilities and limitations of the underlying analog AI hardware. Lead our in-house market analysis team and resources efficiently, so that they support your work and build their own skill set. Translate technical capabilities into customer and application value propositions. Facilitate discussions between technical, commercial and management stakeholders. Challenge our existing assumptions with customer and market evidence. Ensure that product requirements are traceable to actual market needs. Guide future product roadmap decisions. Deliverables You are responsible for producing a professional MRD. Every requirement specified in it is prioritized for each segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases. what you bring Experience in technical marketing, product marketing or application engineering for semiconductors, sensors or embedded systems. Solid understanding of sensor signal chains, low-power electronics and embedded AI, deep enough to discuss architecture trade-offs with chip designers. Extensive experience developing Market Requirements Documents, Product Requirements Documents, market studies or comparable strategic or technical documentation. An established network in smart sensors, Edge AI or semiconductors that gives you direct access to potential customers, domain experts and industry partners, without relying on GEMESYS contacts. Proven ability to independently source, schedule and conduct customer and expert interviews, and to run market validation end to end. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear market and customer requirements. Experience researching technology markets and competitive landscapes. Excellent strategic, analytical and structured thinking skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. Ability to independently conduct research, identify information gaps and develop well-supported conclusions. Domain experience Must have (at least one of the following) Smart sensors Edge AI / TinyML Embedded AI Good to have Analog computing Neuromorphic computing Memristive technology Nice to have Automotive sensing Autonomous systems Wearables or medical devices Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: WHO WE ARE The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result. Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment. We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us. THE ROLE Interdependence is looking for an enthusiastic, detail-oriented individual to support our professional services PR practice. In this role, you'll assist in developing and executing creative PR campaigns, support client relationships, and collaborate closely with a dynamic team. This position is ideal for someone eager to grow their career in public relations, media relations, and client service. Support the development and implementation of strategic PR plans that align with client objectives. Proactively identify opportunities to enhance client results. Creative, curious, and passionate about health and lifestyle storytelling. WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE 🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the world while you enjoy the flexibility of your fully remote workplace. Skip the annoying commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth. 🩺 Comprehensive Health Benefits - Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being. 💰 Retirement Savings - Save for the future with our 401(k) program, including a company match that is increasing further to 3% in 2027 . 🌴 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, 11 company holidays, a floating holiday, and Summer Fridays to recharge and spend more time doing what you love. 👶 Paid Parental Leave - We support growing families with paid parental leave, giving new parents dedicated time to recover, bond with their baby, and return to work with confidence. 📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing strategic integrated marketing and communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people like you grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with meaningful real impact. 🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML , Toolset , and PTC , we’re looking for a hands-on, AI-native marketer who wants to take ownership of marketing and help shape how we do it. AI is a core part of how we work. We’re looking for someone who already uses AI agents, automation, integrations, and structured workflows to get real marketing work done – and can show us what they’ve achieved with them. This is also a technical role . We’ve built our own analytics, newsletter, and marketing automation systems, so you should be comfortable working with technical tools, setting up a local development environment, and using tools like Claude to help you navigate technical tasks. You won’t be joining an established marketing team or following a fixed playbook. You’ll have the freedom to talk to our clients, understand our business, find the strongest opportunities, and decide what marketing should focus on next. What You’ll Work On Several areas currently need an owner: SEO / GEO / AEO Content and collaborations with partners, authors, and bloggers Marketing to existing customers, including retention and expansion Paid advertising Client analytics Other marketing opportunities you identify You’ll work hands-on, from identifying an opportunity through execution, measurement, and improvement. You’ll: Learn our products, industry, competitors, and ecosystem. Speak directly with customers to understand their needs and how they see our products. Look at our data, existing activities, and opportunities. Identify where marketing can have the biggest impact. Build a concrete plan for the areas you propose to own and explain why. What We’re Looking For You already use AI agents, automation, and advanced AI workflows in your everyday work and can show us concrete results. You have experience marketing technical products, ideally software, SaaS, WordPress, or similar. You work independently and can move things forward without detailed instructions. Why Join Us OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007. WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide. You’ll have real ownership and the freedom to help build our marketing approach, work directly with our CEO and product teams, experiment with AI, and turn your ideas into real marketing initiatives. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. If you’re excited about building marketing with AI, getting hands-on, and having the freedom to shape what comes next, we’d love to hear from you. Proficiency in the design tools needed to produce polished graphics and organized, editable files. Initiative and curiosity. You bring curiosity, composure, and humility to your leadership, helping others grow while delivering consistently outstanding creative work.

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.

items.description: Data Scientist, AI/ML Job Description: Today’s complex, fast-paced systems have become a minefield of reliability risks, any of which could cause an outage that costs millions and destroys customer confidence. That’s why high-availability teams use Gremlin to find and fix reliability risks before they become incidents. Gremlin Reliability Platform helps software teams proactively monitor and test their systems for common reliability risks, build and enforce reliability standards, and automate their reliability practices organization-wide. As the industry leader in Chaos Engineering and reliability testing, we work with hundreds of the world’s largest organizations where high availability is non-negotiable. About the Role of the Data Scientist, AI/ML As a Data Scientist, AI/ML at Gremlin, you will have the opportunity to improve the reliability of the internet at large by turning millions of chaos engineering experiments into automated failure analysis and remediation. You will be able to leverage your applied machine learning experience to inform product direction as well as solve complex technical problems that directly impact our customers (which range from the Fortune 500 to smaller organizations). You will work closely with a small, talented engineering team focused on quality, delivery, and predictability with an emphasis on providing our customers a great user experience.
